AI.motivation: 使机器学习模型（特别是前馈神经网络）的查询表达能力更强，将其视为一种意图数据，从而能够使用声明性语言对其进行验证和解释，提高学习表示的可访问性。
AI.method: 调查用于加权结构的逻辑。针对无界神经网络深度，引入递归，重新审视了Grädel和Gurevich提出的函数不动点机制。具体方法包括：采用Datalog风格的语法；将不动点逻辑的范式扩展到加权结构；展示了一种允许覆盖归纳定义的权重函数值的等效“松散”不动点机制；提出了具有多项式时间数据复杂度的“标量”限制的函数不动点逻辑。
AI.result: 提出的“标量”限制的函数不动点逻辑具有多项式时间（PTIME）数据复杂度。它能够表达对具有多项式有界权重的简化网络的所有PTIME模型无关查询。然而，他们也表明，非常简单的模型无关查询已经是NP完全的。
AI.translation: 对机器学习模型进行富有表达力的查询——这被视为一种意图数据的形式——能够使用声明性语言对其进行验证和解释，从而使数据学习表示更易于访问。受前馈神经网络查询的启发，我们研究了用于加权结构的逻辑。在神经网络深度没有界限的情况下，此类逻辑必须包含递归；为此，我们重新审视了Grädel和Gurevich提出的函数不动点机制。我们在类似 Datalog 的语法中采用了该机制；我们将不动点逻辑的范式扩展到加权结构；并展示了一种允许覆盖归纳定义的权重函数值的等效“松散”不动点机制。我们提出了一种函数不动点逻辑的“标量”限制，其数据复杂度为多项式时间，并表明它可以表达对具有多项式有界权重的简化网络的所有 PTIME 模型无关查询。相比之下，我们表明非常简单的模型无关查询已经是 NP 完全的。最后，我们考虑通过迭代转导对加权结构进行的转换。
AI.summary: 本文旨在通过开发用于加权结构的递归逻辑，提高前馈神经网络查询的表达能力和可解释性。作者重新采用了Grädel和Gurevich的函数不动点机制，并将其应用于类似Datalog的语法，同时引入了允许值覆盖的“松散”不动点机制。他们提出了一种具有PTIME数据复杂度的“标量”限制逻辑，证明了其对于PTIME模型无关查询的表达能力，但也指出简单模型无关查询的复杂性可高达NP完全。
AI.keywords: 神经网络查询, 加权结构, 函数不动点逻辑, Datalog, PTIME复杂度
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将声明性逻辑和递归机制（如函数不动点）应用于加权结构，以解决无界深度神经网络的查询和验证问题。通过引入具有PTIME复杂度的“标量”限制，该工作在逻辑表达能力和实际计算可行性之间取得了平衡，这对于提高模型可解释性（XAI）的工具至关重要。然而，关于简单模型无关查询的NP完全性结果揭示了在保持低计算复杂度的同时实现全面查询表达能力的内在挑战。

title: Counterfactual Fairness with Graph Uncertainty
comments: Peer reviewed pre-print. Presented at the BIAS 2025 Workshop at ECML PKDD
summary: Evaluating machine learning (ML) model bias is key to building trustworthy and robust ML systems. Counterfactual Fairness (CF) audits allow the measurement of bias of ML models with a causal framework, yet their conclusions rely on a single causal graph that is rarely known with certainty in real-world scenarios. We propose CF with Graph Uncertainty (CF-GU), a bias evaluation procedure that incorporates the uncertainty of specifying a causal graph into CF. CF-GU (i) bootstraps a Causal Discovery algorithm under domain knowledge constraints to produce a bag of plausible Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs), (ii) quantifies graph uncertainty with the normalized Shannon entropy, and (iii) provides confidence bounds on CF metrics. Experiments on synthetic data show how contrasting domain knowledge assumptions support or refute audits of CF, while experiments on real-world data (COMPAS and Adult datasets) pinpoint well-known biases with high confidence, even when supplied with minimal domain knowledge constraints.
comment: Peer reviewed pre-print. Presented at the BIAS 2025 Workshop at ECML PKDD

AI.title_translation: 具有图不确定性的反事实公平性
AI.tldr: 针对反事实公平性（CF）依赖单一且不确定的因果图的问题，本文提出了CF-GU方法。CF-GU通过引导因果发现算法生成多个可能的图，使用香农熵量化图的不确定性，并提供CF指标的置信区间，实验证明该方法能高置信度地识别真实世界数据中的偏见。
AI.motivation: 评估机器学习模型偏差对于构建可信赖的系统至关重要。反事实公平性（CF）审计依赖于因果框架，但其结论基于一个在现实世界中很少能确定已知的单一因果图，这是一个重要的局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“具有图不确定性的反事实公平性”（CF-GU）的偏差评估程序。该方法包括三个步骤：（i）在领域知识约束下引导（bootstraps）因果发现算法，生成一组可信的有向无环图（DAGs）；（ii）使用归一化香农熵量化图的不确定性；（iii）提供CF指标的置信区间。
AI.result: 在合成数据上的实验表明，不同的领域知识假设可以支持或驳斥CF审计的结论。在真实世界数据（COMPAS和Adult数据集）上的实验表明，即使只提供最少的领域知识约束，CF-GU也能高置信度地查明众所周知的偏见。
AI.translation: 评估机器学习（ML）模型偏差是构建可信赖和鲁棒的ML系统的关键。反事实公平性（CF）审计允许使用因果框架来衡量ML模型的偏差，但其结论依赖于一个在现实场景中很少能确定已知的单一因果图。我们提出了具有图不确定性的反事实公平性（CF-GU），这是一种将因果图规范的不确定性纳入CF的偏差评估程序。CF-GU（i）在领域知识约束下引导因果发现算法，以生成一组合理的有向无环图（DAGs），（ii）使用归一化香农熵量化图的不确定性，以及（iii）提供CF指标的置信区间。在合成数据上的实验表明，相互矛盾的领域知识假设如何支持或驳斥CF审计，而对真实世界数据（COMPAS和Adult数据集）的实验表明，即使只提供最少的领域知识约束，也能高置信度地查明众所周知的偏见。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CF-GU（具有图不确定性的反事实公平性）的机器学习模型偏差评估方法，旨在解决传统反事实公平性（CF）审计对单一、不确定因果图的依赖问题。CF-GU通过引导因果发现算法结合领域知识，生成并量化（使用香农熵）多个可能的因果图的不确定性，从而为CF指标提供置信区间。实验证明，该方法在合成数据上能够体现领域知识假设的影响，并在COMPAS和Adult等真实数据集上，即使在最小约束条件下，也能高置信度地识别既有偏见。
AI.keywords: 反事实公平性, 图不确定性, 因果发现, 偏差评估, 香农熵
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它解决了因果公平性评估中的一个核心实际挑战：因果图的不确定性。传统的反事实公平性（CF）方法假设因果结构是确定的，但在现实应用中，这种假设往往不成立。CF-GU通过集成因果发现（Causal Discovery）和熵量化（Shannon entropy）来系统地处理这种不确定性，从而使其公平性审计结果更具鲁棒性和可信度。为CF指标提供置信区间，使得审计结论不再是二元的“公平”或“不公平”，而是具有量化不确定性的结果，这对构建实际可部署的、负责任的AI系统具有重要意义。

title: InfiAgent: An Infinite-Horizon Framework for General-Purpose Autonomous Agents
summary: LLM agents can reason and use tools, but they often break down on long-horizon tasks due to unbounded context growth and accumulated errors. Common remedies such as context compression or retrieval-augmented prompting introduce trade-offs between information fidelity and reasoning stability. We present InfiAgent, a general-purpose framework that keeps the agent's reasoning context strictly bounded regardless of task duration by externalizing persistent state into a file-centric state abstraction. At each step, the agent reconstructs context from a workspace state snapshot plus a fixed window of recent actions. Experiments on DeepResearch and an 80-paper literature review task show that, without task-specific fine-tuning, InfiAgent with a 20B open-source model is competitive with larger proprietary systems and maintains substantially higher long-horizon coverage than context-centric baselines. These results support explicit state externalization as a practical foundation for stable long-horizon agents. Github Repo:https://github.com/ChenglinPoly/infiAgent

AI.title_translation: InfiAgent：一个用于通用自主智能体的无限范围框架
AI.tldr: InfiAgent是一个新的LLM智能体框架，通过将持久状态外部化为文件中心抽象来严格限制上下文增长，从而解决了长程任务中的上下文爆炸和错误累积问题。它在长程任务中的表现优于基于上下文的基线模型，甚至能与更大的专有系统竞争。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体在长程任务中因上下文无限增长和错误累积而经常失败。常见的补救措施（如上下文压缩或检索增强提示）在信息保真度和推理稳定性之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出了InfiAgent框架。它通过将持久状态外部化到一个文件中心的抽象中，严格限制了智能体的推理上下文，使其不受任务持续时间影响。在每一步中，智能体从工作区状态快照和固定窗口的最近动作中重建上下文。
AI.result: 在DeepResearch和一项80篇论文的文献综述任务上进行了实验。InfiAgent（使用20B开源模型）在无需任务特定微调的情况下，与更大的专有系统具有竞争力，并且比基于上下文的基线模型保持了更高的长程覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果支持将显式状态外部化作为构建稳定长程智能体的一个实用基础。
AI.translation: LLM智能体可以进行推理和使用工具，但由于上下文的无限增长和错误的累积，它们在长程任务中往往会崩溃。常见的补救措施，如上下文压缩或检索增强提示，在信息保真度和推理稳定性之间引入了权衡。我们提出了InfiAgent，这是一个通用框架，通过将持久状态外部化为一个以文件为中心的抽象，无论任务持续时间如何，都能严格限制智能体的推理上下文。在每一步中，智能体都会从工作区状态快照加上固定窗口的最近动作中重建上下文。在DeepResearch和一项80篇论文的文献综述任务上的实验表明，在没有任务特定微调的情况下，使用20B开源模型的InfiAgent与更大的专有系统具有竞争力，并且比基于上下文的基线模型保持了更高的长程覆盖率。这些结果支持将显式状态外部化作为稳定长程智能体的一个实用基础。
AI.summary: InfiAgent是一个解决LLM智能体在长程任务中因上下文爆炸和错误累积而失败的通用框架。它通过将持久状态外部化到文件系统抽象中，确保推理上下文始终严格受限。实验证明，该框架在使用20B开源模型时，在长程任务覆盖率上明显优于基于上下文的基线模型，并能与大型专有系统相媲美。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 无限范围, 状态外部化, 上下文限制, 文件中心抽象
AI.comments: InfiAgent的创新点在于其“无限范围”设计，它通过放弃传统的长上下文管理，转而采用“状态外部化”的范式，解决了LLM智能体在处理复杂、多步骤任务时的根本性瓶颈。这种文件中心的抽象方法将任务进度和必要信息存储在上下文窗口之外，极大地提高了智能体长期运行的稳定性和鲁棒性。它证明了即使是较小的开源模型，通过优秀的设计框架，也能在复杂任务中达到与更大、更昂贵的专有模型相当的性能。

title: UltraLogic: Enhancing LLM Reasoning through Large-Scale Data Synthesis and Bipolar Float Reward
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in natural language processing , complex general-purpose reasoning requiring multi-step logic, planning, and verification remains a critical bottleneck. Although Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has succeeded in specific domains , the field lacks large-scale, high-quality, and difficulty-calibrated data for general reasoning. To address this, we propose UltraLogic, a framework that decouples the logical core of a problem from its natural language expression through a Code-based Solving methodology to automate high-quality data production. The framework comprises hundreds of unique task types and an automated calibration pipeline across ten difficulty levels. Furthermore, to mitigate binary reward sparsity and the Non-negative Reward Trap, we introduce the Bipolar Float Reward (BFR) mechanism, utilizing graded penalties to effectively distinguish perfect responses from those with logical flaws. Our experiments demonstrate that task diversity is the primary driver for reasoning enhancement , and that BFR, combined with a difficulty matching strategy, significantly improves training efficiency, guiding models toward global logical optima.

AI.title_translation: UltraLogic：通过大规模数据合成和双极浮动奖励增强LLM推理能力
AI.tldr: 提出UltraLogic框架，通过基于代码的解决（Code-based Solving）方法大规模生成高质量、难度分级的通用推理数据，并引入双极浮动奖励（BFR）机制来解决二元奖励稀疏性问题，显著提高了LLM的推理能力和训练效率。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言处理方面潜力巨大，但需要多步逻辑、规划和验证的复杂通用推理仍然是瓶颈。现有的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方法缺乏大规模、高质量、且难度经过校准的通用推理数据。
AI.method: 提出UltraLogic框架。该框架采用“基于代码的解决”（Code-based Solving）方法，将问题的逻辑核心与自然语言表达解耦，以自动化生成高质量数据。该框架包含数百种独特的任务类型和跨十个难度级别的自动化校准流程。此外，引入了双极浮动奖励（BFR）机制，利用分级惩罚来区分完美响应和有逻辑缺陷的响应，以减轻二元奖励稀疏性和非负奖励陷阱。
AI.result: 实验证明，任务多样性是增强推理能力的主要驱动力。结合难度匹配策略的BFR机制显著提高了训练效率，并引导模型达到全局逻辑最优。
AI.conclusion: 任务多样性对推理增强至关重要。双极浮动奖励（BFR）机制结合难度匹配策略，能有效提高训练效率，帮助模型找到全局逻辑最优解。
AI.translation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言处理中展现出巨大潜力，但需要多步逻辑、规划和验证的复杂通用推理仍然是一个关键瓶颈。虽然可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已在特定领域取得成功，但该领域缺乏大规模、高质量且难度经过校准的通用推理数据。为解决此问题，我们提出了UltraLogic框架，该框架通过“基于代码的解决”方法将问题的逻辑核心与其自然语言表达解耦，从而实现高质量数据的自动化生产。该框架包含数百种独特的任务类型和跨越十个难度级别的自动化校准流程。此外，为缓解二元奖励稀疏性和非负奖励陷阱，我们引入了双极浮动奖励（BFR）机制，利用分级惩罚来有效区分完美响应和具有逻辑缺陷的响应。我们的实验证明，任务多样性是推理增强的主要驱动力，并且BFR结合难度匹配策略显著提高了训练效率，引导模型趋向全局逻辑最优。
AI.summary: 本文提出了UltraLogic框架，旨在解决LLM在复杂通用推理中的数据和奖励瓶颈。UltraLogic通过“基于代码的解决”方法自动化生成大规模、高质量、且难度分级（百种任务类型、十个难度级别）的推理数据。同时，引入双极浮动奖励（BFR）机制，通过分级惩罚克服了传统二元奖励的稀疏性和非负奖励陷阱。实验结果表明，任务多样性是推理能力提升的关键，而BFR结合难度匹配策略能显著提升训练效率，帮助模型实现最优逻辑表现。
AI.keywords: LLM推理, 大规模数据合成, 双极浮动奖励 (BFR), 强化学习, 难度校准
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于系统性地解决了通用推理任务中数据和奖励机制的不足。通过“基于代码的解决”方法，实现了逻辑核心与自然语言表达的解耦，为大规模、高质量、难度可控的数据集创建提供了新范式。双极浮动奖励（BFR）机制是另一个重要贡献，它通过引入惩罚（负奖励）来细致区分逻辑质量，有效缓解了强化学习中常见的奖励稀疏性问题和非负奖励陷阱，有助于模型更精确地学习逻辑最优路径，显著提升了训练效率。

title: Fine-tuning Small Language Models as Efficient Enterprise Search Relevance Labelers
summary: In enterprise search, building high-quality datasets at scale remains a central challenge due to the difficulty of acquiring labeled data. To resolve this challenge, we propose an efficient approach to fine-tune small language models (SLMs) for accurate relevance labeling, enabling high-throughput, domain-specific labeling comparable or even better in quality to that of state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs). To overcome the lack of high-quality and accessible datasets in the enterprise domain, our method leverages on synthetic data generation. Specifically, we employ an LLM to synthesize realistic enterprise queries from a seed document, apply BM25 to retrieve hard negatives, and use a teacher LLM to assign relevance scores. The resulting dataset is then distilled into an SLM, producing a compact relevance labeler. We evaluate our approach on a high-quality benchmark consisting of 923 enterprise query-document pairs annotated by trained human annotators, and show that the distilled SLM achieves agreement with human judgments on par with or better than the teacher LLM. Furthermore, our fine-tuned labeler substantially improves throughput, achieving 17 times increase while also being 19 times more cost-effective. This approach enables scalable and cost-effective relevance labeling for enterprise-scale retrieval applications, supporting rapid offline evaluation and iteration in real-world settings.

AI.title_translation: 将小型语言模型微调为高效的企业搜索相关性标注器
AI.tldr: 针对企业搜索缺乏高质量标注数据的挑战，本文提出利用教师LLM生成合成数据，并将其蒸馏到SLM中。微调后的SLM作为相关性标注器，其准确性与教师LLM相当或更优，同时吞吐量提高了17倍，成本效益提高了19倍。
AI.motivation: 在企业搜索中，由于难以获取标注数据，大规模构建高质量数据集是一个核心挑战。本文旨在通过微调小型语言模型（SLM）来解决这一问题，实现高吞吐量、领域特定的准确相关性标注。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于合成数据生成和知识蒸馏的方法。首先，利用一个大型语言模型（LLM）从种子文档中合成逼真的企业查询；其次，应用BM25检索难负例；然后，使用一个教师LLM分配相关性分数，创建合成数据集。最后，将该数据集蒸馏到一个小型语言模型（SLM）中，从而得到一个紧凑的相关性标注器。
AI.result: 蒸馏后的SLM与人类判断的一致性与教师LLM相当或更优。此外，微调后的标注器大幅提高了吞吐量（提高了17倍），同时成本效益提高了19倍。
AI.conclusion: 这种方法为企业级检索应用提供了可扩展且具有成本效益的相关性标注，支持在实际环境中快速进行离线评估和迭代。
AI.translation: 在企业搜索中，由于获取标注数据的难度，大规模构建高质量数据集仍然是一个核心挑战。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种有效的方法来微调小型语言模型（SLMs），以实现准确的相关性标注，从而实现高吞吐量、领域特定的标注，其质量可与最先进的大型语言模型（LLMs）相媲美，甚至更优。为了克服企业领域缺乏高质量和可获取数据集的问题，我们的方法利用了合成数据生成。具体来说，我们使用一个LLM从种子文档中合成逼真的企业查询，应用BM25检索难负例，并使用一个教师LLM分配相关性分数。然后，将由此产生的数据集蒸馏到SLM中，生成一个紧凑的相关性标注器。我们在一个由经过培训的人工标注员标注的包含923个企业查询-文档对的高质量基准上评估了我们的方法，结果表明，蒸馏后的SLM与人类判断的一致性与教师LLM相当或更优。此外，我们微调后的标注器大幅提高了吞吐量，实现了17倍的增长，同时成本效益提高了19倍。这种方法为企业级检索应用提供了可扩展且具有成本效益的相关性标注，支持在实际环境中快速进行离线评估和迭代。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种高效的方法，通过知识蒸馏将大型语言模型（LLM）教师的知识转移到小型语言模型（SLM）中，从而创建企业搜索相关性标注器。该方法利用LLM生成合成查询和难负例，并分配相关性分数，以解决企业域标注数据稀缺的问题。实验证明，微调后的SLM在标注质量上与人类判断的一致性与教师LLM相当或更优，同时在吞吐量和成本效益上分别实现了17倍和19倍的显著提升，从而实现了企业级应用的可扩展和经济高效的标注解决方案。
AI.keywords: 小型语言模型, 企业搜索, 相关性标注, 知识蒸馏, 合成数据生成
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将知识蒸馏和合成数据生成相结合，解决了企业搜索领域高质量标注数据稀缺的实际痛点。通过将标注任务从昂贵的LLM转移到高效的SLM，作者成功地在保持甚至超越标注质量的同时，实现了巨大的成本和速度优势。这对于需要快速迭代和大规模离线评估的企业检索系统具有重要的实际价值。这种方法为在资源受限或需要高频次标注的场景中部署领域特定标注模型提供了一个优秀的范例。

title: Critic-Guided Reinforcement Unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion
summary: Machine unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models aims to remove targeted concepts while preserving overall utility. Prior diffusion unlearning methods typically rely on supervised weight edits or global penalties; reinforcement-learning (RL) approaches, while flexible, often optimize sparse end-of-trajectory rewards, yielding high-variance updates and weak credit assignment. We present a general RL framework for diffusion unlearning that treats denoising as a sequential decision process and introduces a timestep-aware critic with noisy-step rewards. Concretely, we train a CLIP-based reward predictor on noisy latents and use its per-step signal to compute advantage estimates for policy-gradient updates of the reverse diffusion kernel. Our algorithm is simple to implement, supports off-policy reuse, and plugs into standard text-to-image backbones. Across multiple concepts, the method achieves better or comparable forgetting to strong baselines while maintaining image quality and benign prompt fidelity; ablations show that (i) per-step critics and (ii) noisy-conditioned rewards are key to stability and effectiveness. We release code and evaluation scripts to facilitate reproducibility and future research on RL-based diffusion unlearning.

AI.title_translation: 评论家引导的文本到图像扩散模型中的强化遗忘
AI.tldr: 针对文本到图像扩散模型的概念遗忘问题，本文提出了一种新的强化学习框架，通过引入时间步感知的评论家和基于噪声的每步奖励，解决了现有RL方法的稀疏奖励和高方差问题，实现了稳定且高效的概念遗忘。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型中的机器遗忘旨在移除目标概念，同时保持整体实用性。现有的遗忘方法依赖于监督权重编辑或全局惩罚；而现有的强化学习方法通常优化稀疏的轨迹末端奖励，导致更新方差大且信用分配弱。
AI.method: 提出了一种通用的强化学习（RL）框架用于扩散模型遗忘，将去噪视为一个序列决策过程。该框架引入了一个时间步感知的评论家（critic）和带噪声步长的奖励。具体来说，它训练一个基于CLIP的奖励预测器来处理带噪声的潜在表示，并利用其每一步信号计算优势估计，用于反向扩散核的策略梯度更新。该算法支持离策略重用，并可接入标准的文本到图像骨干网络。
AI.result: 在多个概念上，该方法实现了与强基线相比更好或相当的遗忘效果，同时保持了图像质量和良性提示的保真度。消融实验表明，（i）每一步评论家和（ii）基于噪声条件下的奖励是实现稳定性和有效性的关键。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入时间步感知的评论家和基于噪声的每步奖励，本文提出的强化学习框架成功解决了现有RL遗忘方法中稀疏奖励和高方差的局限性，实现了稳定且有效的概念遗忘，同时保持了模型性能。
AI.translation: 文本到图像扩散模型中的机器遗忘旨在移除目标概念，同时保持整体实用性。先前的扩散模型遗忘方法通常依赖于监督权重编辑或全局惩罚；而强化学习（RL）方法虽然灵活，但通常优化稀疏的轨迹末端奖励，导致高方差更新和薄弱的信用分配。我们提出了一个通用的RL框架用于扩散模型遗忘，将去噪视为一个序列决策过程，并引入了一个时间步感知的评论家和带噪声步长的奖励。具体来说，我们训练了一个基于CLIP的奖励预测器来处理带噪声的潜在表示，并利用其每一步信号来计算优势估计，用于反向扩散核的策略梯度更新。我们的算法易于实现，支持离策略重用，并可接入标准的文本到图像骨干网络。在多个概念上，该方法实现了与强基线相比更好或相当的遗忘效果，同时保持了图像质量和良性提示的保真度；消融实验表明，（i）每一步评论家和（ii）基于噪声条件下的奖励是实现稳定性和有效性的关键。我们发布了代码和评估脚本，以促进可复现性和未来基于RL的扩散模型遗忘研究。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个评论家引导的强化学习（RL）框架，用于文本到图像扩散模型中的机器遗忘。该框架将去噪过程建模为序列决策，并引入了一个基于CLIP、时间步感知的评论家，提供带噪声潜在表示的每步奖励信号。这种设计解决了传统RL遗忘方法中稀疏奖励和高方差更新的问题。实验证明，该方法在保持图像质量的同时，实现了与现有强基线相当或更优的遗忘效果，其稳定性和有效性主要归功于每步评论家和噪声条件奖励。
AI.keywords: 强化遗忘, 文本到图像扩散, 评论家引导, 机器遗忘, 强化学习
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将强化学习（RL）应用于扩散模型的机器遗忘任务，并巧妙地解决了RL在该领域的核心挑战——稀疏奖励和信用分配问题。通过引入时间步感知的评论家（Critic-Guided）和基于噪声的每步奖励，作者将传统的全局、稀疏奖励转化为密集的、局部的反馈信号。这显著提高了策略更新的稳定性和效率，为使用RL方法处理复杂的生成模型编辑任务提供了一个通用且有效的范例。

title: oneTwin: Online Digital Network Twin via Neural Radio Radiance Field
comments: This paper is accepted by IEEE INFOCOM 2026
summary: Digital network twin is a promising technology that replicates real-world networks in real-time and assists with the design, operation, and management of next-generation networks. However, existing approaches (e.g., simulator-based and neural-based) cannot effectively realize the digital network twin, in terms of fidelity, synchronicity, and tractability. In this paper, we propose oneTwin, the first online digital twin system, for the prediction of physical layer metrics. We architect the oneTwin system with two primary components: an enhanced simulator and a neural radio radiance field (NRRF). On the one hand, we achieve the enhanced simulator by designing a material tuning algorithm that incrementally optimizes the building materials to minimize the twin-to-real gap. On the other hand, we achieve the NRRF by designing a neural learning algorithm that continually updates its DNNs based on both online and simulated data from the enhanced simulator. We implement oneTwin system using Sionna RT as the simulator and developing new DNNs as the NRRF, under a public cellular network. Extensive experimental results show that, compared to state-of-the-art solutions, oneTwin achieves real-time updating (0.98s), with 36.39% and 57.50% reductions of twin-to-real gap under in-distribution and out-of-distribution test datasets, respectively.
comment: This paper is accepted by IEEE INFOCOM 2026

AI.title_translation: 在线数字网络孪生：通过神经无线电辐射场实现
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了oneTwin，一个用于预测物理层指标的在线数字网络孪生系统，通过增强的模拟器和神经无线电辐射场（NRRF）实现，显著减少了孪生与现实之间的差距，并实现了实时更新。
AI.motivation: 现有数字网络孪生方法在保真度、同步性和可处理性方面存在不足，无法有效实现下一代网络的数字孪生。
AI.method: 提出oneTwin系统，包含一个增强的模拟器（通过材料调优算法优化建筑材料以最小化孪生-现实差距）和一个神经无线电辐射场（NRRF）（通过神经学习算法更新DNN以基于在线和模拟数据进行学习）。
AI.result: oneTwin实现了0.98秒的实时更新，在分布内和分布外测试数据集上分别将孪生-现实差距减少了36.39%和57.50%。
AI.conclusion: oneTwin是首个在线数字孪生系统，通过其独特的架构和算法，在预测物理层指标方面取得了显著的准确性和实时性，优于现有解决方案。
AI.translation: 数字网络孪生是一项有前途的技术，可以实时复制现实世界的网络，并协助下一代网络的设计、运行和管理。然而，现有方法（例如基于模拟器和基于神经网络的方法）在保真度、同步性和可处理性方面未能有效实现数字网络孪生。在本文中，我们提出了oneTwin，首个用于预测物理层指标的在线数字孪生系统。我们使用增强的模拟器和神经无线电辐射场（NRRF）这两个主要组件来构建oneTwin系统。一方面，我们通过设计一种材料调优算法来增强模拟器，该算法通过增量优化建筑材料来最小化孪生-现实差距。另一方面，我们通过设计一种神经学习算法来获得NRRF，该算法基于增强模拟器的在线和模拟数据持续更新其深度神经网络（DNN）。我们使用Sionna RT作为模拟器，并开发新的DNN作为NRRF，在一个公共蜂窝网络中实现了oneTwin系统。广泛的实验结果表明，与最先进的解决方案相比，oneTwin实现了实时更新（0.98秒），在分布内和分布外测试数据集上分别将孪生-现实差距减少了36.39%和57.50%。
AI.summary: oneTwin是一个新颖的在线数字网络孪生系统，它通过结合一个优化的模拟器和一个基于神经网络的无线电辐射场（NRRF）来实时预测物理层指标。该系统通过持续学习和优化，显著提高了孪生模型的准确性，并实现了近乎实时的更新，为下一代网络的设计和管理提供了更有效的工具。
AI.keywords: 数字网络孪生, 神经无线电辐射场, 在线学习, 物理层预测, 实时更新
AI.comments: 该研究在数字网络孪生领域取得了重要进展，特别是在实时性和准确性方面。通过引入NRRF和材料调优算法，oneTwin有效地解决了现有方法的局限性。然而，该方法在实际大规模部署中的可扩展性和鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。

title: MalruleLib: Large-Scale Executable Misconception Reasoning with Step Traces for Modeling Student Thinking in Mathematics
summary: Student mistakes in mathematics are often systematic: a learner applies a coherent but wrong procedure and repeats it across contexts. We introduce MalruleLib, a learning-science-grounded framework that translates documented misconceptions into executable procedures, drawing on 67 learning-science and mathematics education sources, and generates step-by-step traces of malrule-consistent student work. We formalize a core student-modeling problem as Malrule Reasoning Accuracy (MRA): infer a misconception from one worked mistake and predict the student's next answer under cross-template rephrasing. Across nine language models (4B-120B), accuracy drops from 66% on direct problem solving to 40% on cross-template misconception prediction. MalruleLib encodes 101 malrules over 498 parameterized problem templates and produces paired dual-path traces for both correct reasoning and malrule-consistent student reasoning. Because malrules are executable and templates are parameterizable, MalruleLib can generate over one million instances, enabling scalable supervision and controlled evaluation. Using MalruleLib, we observe cross-template degradations of 10-21%, while providing student step traces improves prediction by 3-15%. We release MalruleLib as infrastructure for educational AI that models student procedures across contexts, enabling diagnosis and feedback that targets the underlying misconception.

AI.title_translation: MalruleLib：大规模可执行错误推理与步骤追踪，用于数学学生思维建模
AI.tldr: MalruleLib是一个框架，将数学中的学生错误（malrules）转化为可执行程序，并生成学生解题步骤的追踪记录。它能够生成大量模拟学生错误解题过程的实例，用于训练和评估AI模型。研究发现，在跨模板问题中预测学生错误比直接解题更具挑战性，但提供学生解题步骤的追踪信息有助于提高预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 数学学习中学生错误往往是系统性的，表现为应用一套连贯但错误的解题程序。理解和建模这些系统性错误对于提供有效的诊断和反馈至关重要。
AI.method: MalruleLib框架将已知的学生错误（malrules）转化为可执行程序，并利用67个学习科学和数学教育来源的文献。它生成模拟学生错误解题过程的步骤追踪记录（step traces）。该框架包含101种malrules和498个参数化问题模板，可生成超过一百万个实例。研究将核心的学生建模问题形式化为Malrule推理准确性（MRA），即从一个错误解题实例推断学生的错误规则，并预测其在不同问题模板下的下一个答案。
AI.result: 在九种语言模型（4B-120B参数）上进行评估，发现模型在直接解题任务上的准确率为66%，但在跨模板的错误推理预测任务上准确率下降至40%。使用MalruleLib，研究观察到跨模板预测准确率下降10-21%，而提供学生解题步骤追踪信息可将预测准确率提高3-15%。
AI.conclusion: MalruleLib作为一个可扩展的教育AI基础设施，能够模拟学生跨上下文的解题程序，为诊断和针对根本性错误进行反馈提供了可能。研究结果表明，理解和预测学生系统性错误是AI在教育领域面临的挑战，但提供的详细解题步骤有助于提升模型性能。
AI.translation: 学生在数学上的错误往往是有系统性的：学习者会应用一套连贯但错误的程序，并在不同情境下重复使用。我们引入了MalruleLib，一个以学习科学为基础的框架，它将已记录的错误概念转化为可执行程序，借鉴了67个学习科学和数学教育来源的文献，并生成了符合错误规则的学生解题步骤追踪。我们将一个核心的学生建模问题形式化为Malrule推理准确性（MRA）：从一个解出的错误推断一个错误概念，并在跨模板改写下预测学生的下一个答案。在九种语言模型（4B-120B）上，准确率从直接解题的66%下降到跨模板错误概念预测的40%。MalruleLib在498个参数化问题模板上编码了101个错误规则，并为正确推理和符合错误规则的学生推理生成了成对的双路径追踪。由于错误规则是可执行的，模板是可参数化的，MalruleLib可以生成超过一百万个实例，从而实现可扩展的监督和受控评估。利用MalruleLib，我们观察到跨模板的准确率下降了10-21%，同时提供学生步骤追踪将预测准确率提高了3-15%。我们将MalruleLib作为一个教育AI的基础设施发布，用于模拟跨上下文的学生程序，从而实现针对根本性错误概念的诊断和反馈。
AI.summary: MalruleLib是一个新框架，旨在通过将数学中的学生错误（malrules）转化为可执行程序并生成详细的解题步骤追踪，来模拟和推理学生的数学思维过程。该框架包含大量的错误规则和问题模板，能够生成海量数据用于模型训练和评估。研究表明，在跨不同问题模板时预测学生的错误比直接解题更困难，但提供学生解题步骤信息能有效提升AI模型的预测准确性。
AI.keywords: 学生错误推理, 数学教育, 语言模型, 学习科学, AI基础设施
AI.comments: 该研究提出的MalruleLib框架在教育AI领域具有重要的创新性和实用价值。它不仅能够系统性地模拟和理解学生在数学学习中的常见错误，还能生成大规模、多样化的数据集，为训练更智能的教育AI助手提供了坚实的基础。将学习科学理论转化为可执行的代码是该研究的一大亮点，使得AI能够更深入地理解学生的认知过程。然而，该研究也指出了跨模板预测学生错误这一挑战，这表明即使有详细的步骤追踪，AI在泛化和理解深层数学概念方面仍有提升空间。未来的研究可以进一步探索如何提高AI在处理新颖或复杂问题时的鲁棒性，以及如何更有效地将MalruleLib的诊断能力转化为个性化的教学干预。

title: Enhancing Safety in Automated Ports: A Virtual Reality Study of Pedestrian-Autonomous Vehicle Interactions under Time Pressure, Visual Constraints, and Varying Vehicle Size
summary: Autonomous driving improves traffic efficiency but presents safety challenges in complex port environments. This study investigates how environmental factors, traffic factors, and pedestrian characteristics influence interaction safety between autonomous vehicles and pedestrians in ports. Using virtual reality (VR) simulations of typical port scenarios, 33 participants completed pedestrian crossing tasks under varying visibility, vehicle sizes, and time pressure conditions. Results indicate that low-visibility conditions, partial occlusions and larger vehicle sizes significantly increase perceived risk, prompting pedestrians to wait longer and accept larger gaps. Specifically, pedestrians tended to accept larger gaps and waited longer when interacting with large autonomous truck platoons, reflecting heightened caution due to their perceived threat. However, local obstructions also reduce post-encroachment time, compressing safety margins. Individual attributes such as age, gender, and driving experience further shape decision-making, while time pressure undermines compensatory behaviors and increases risk. Based on these findings, safety strategies are proposed, including installing wide-angle cameras at multiple viewpoints, enabling real-time vehicle-infrastructure communication, enhancing port lighting and signage, and strengthening pedestrian safety training. This study offers practical recommendations for improving the safety and deployment of vision-based autonomous systems in port settings.

AI.title_translation: 提高自动化港口的安全性：一项关于时间压力、视觉限制和不同车辆尺寸下行人与自动驾驶汽车交互的虚拟现实研究
AI.tldr: 在港口环境下，行人和自动驾驶汽车的交互受到能见度、车辆大小和时间压力的影响。降低能见度、增大车辆尺寸和存在遮挡会增加行人的风险感知，导致他们等待更长时间并接受更大的安全距离。然而，局部遮挡也会缩短安全时间。个体因素和时间压力也会影响决策。研究提出了提高安全性的策略，如安装广角摄像头、加强车路通信、改善港口照明和标识以及加强行人培训。
AI.motivation: 随着自动驾驶技术在港口等复杂环境中应用，行人与自动驾驶汽车的交互安全性面临挑战。本研究旨在探讨环境、交通因素及行人特征如何影响港口场景下行人与自动驾驶汽车的交互安全性。
AI.method: 利用虚拟现实（VR）模拟了典型的港口场景，让33名参与者在不同能见度、车辆尺寸和时间压力条件下完成行人过马路任务。
AI.result: 低能见度、部分遮挡和较大的车辆尺寸会显著增加感知风险，导致行人等待更长时间并接受更大的安全距离。特别是，行人与大型自动驾驶卡车编队交互时，会因感知到的威胁而表现出更高的警惕性，接受更大的安全距离并等待更长时间。然而，局部遮挡也会缩短安全时间，压缩安全边际。年龄、性别和驾驶经验等个体属性会影响决策，而时间压力会削弱补偿行为并增加风险。
AI.conclusion: 基于研究结果，提出了具体的安全策略，包括安装多角度广角摄像头、实现车路实时通信、改善港口照明和标识以及加强行人安全培训。这些建议旨在提高基于视觉的自动驾驶系统在港口的安全性与部署效率。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶提高了交通效率，但也给复杂的港口环境带来了安全挑战。本研究调查了环境因素、交通因素和行人特征如何影响港口中自动驾驶汽车与行人之间的交互安全性。利用典型港口场景的虚拟现实（VR）模拟，33名参与者在不同能见度、车辆尺寸和时间压力条件下完成了行人过马路任务。结果表明，低能见度条件、部分遮挡和较大的车辆尺寸显著增加了感知风险，促使行人等待更长时间并接受更大的安全距离。特别是，行人与大型自动驾驶卡车编队交互时，会因其感知到的威胁而表现出更高的警惕性，接受更大的安全距离并等待更长时间。然而，局部遮挡也会缩短接触后时间，压缩安全边际。年龄、性别和驾驶经验等个体属性进一步影响决策，而时间压力则削弱了补偿行为并增加了风险。基于这些发现，提出了安全策略，包括安装多角度广角摄像头、实现车路实时通信、改善港口照明和标识以及加强行人安全培训。本研究为提高港口环境中基于视觉的自动驾驶系统的安全性和部署提供了实际建议。
AI.summary: 本研究利用虚拟现实技术，在模拟的港口环境中，探究了时间压力、视觉限制（如低能见度和遮挡）以及车辆尺寸等因素对行人与自动驾驶汽车交互安全性的影响。研究发现，恶劣的视觉条件、大型车辆以及遮挡会增加行人的风险感知，导致他们采取更保守的过路行为。个体差异和时间压力也对行人决策有显著影响。最后，研究基于实验结果提出了一系列旨在提升港口自动驾驶安全性的实用建议。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 港口安全, 虚拟现实, 行人交互, 风险感知
AI.comments: 该研究利用VR技术模拟真实港口环境，为研究行人与自动驾驶汽车交互提供了有效的平台。研究结果具有较高的实践指导意义，提出的安全策略具有前瞻性。然而，VR模拟的真实性以及参与者在模拟环境中的行为与真实情境的差异可能需要进一步探讨。

title: inRAN: Interpretable Online Bayesian Learning for Network Automation in Open Radio Access Networks
comments: This paper is accepted by IEEE INFOCOM 2026
summary: Emerging AI/ML techniques have been showing great potential in automating network control in open radio access networks (Open RAN). However, existing approaches heavily rely on blackbox policies parameterized by deep neural networks, which inherently lack interpretability, explainability, and transparency, and create substantial obstacles in practical network deployment. In this paper, we propose inRAN, a novel interpretable online Bayesian learning framework for network automation in Open RAN. The core idea is to integrate interpretable surrogate models and safe optimization solvers to continually optimize control actions, while adapting to non-stationary dynamics in real-world networks. We achieve the inRAN framework with three key components: 1) an interpretable surrogate model via ensembling Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs); 2) safe optimization solvers via integrating genetic search and trust-region descent method; 3) an online dynamics tracker via continual model learning and adaptive threshold offset. We implement inRAN in an end-to-end O-RAN-compliant network testbed, and conduct extensive over-the-air experiments with the focused use case of network slicing. The results show that, inRAN substantially outperforms state-of-the-art works, by guaranteeing the chance-based constraint with a 92.67% assurance ratio with comparative resource usage throughout the online network control, under unforeseeable time-evolving network dynamics.
comment: This paper is accepted by IEEE INFOCOM 2026

AI.title_translation: inRAN：面向开放无线接入网网络自动化的可解释在线贝叶斯学习框架
AI.tldr: 为了解决Open RAN自动化中AI模型的黑盒问题，研究人员提出了inRAN，一个结合了可解释的KANs模型和安全优化求解器的在线贝叶斯学习框架。该框架通过持续学习和安全优化，在网络切片任务中实现了比现有方法更可靠、更透明的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的网络自动化方法严重依赖于深度神经网络参数化的黑盒策略，这些策略本质上缺乏可解释性、可解释性和透明度，给实际网络部署带来了巨大障碍。因此，需要一种可解释的在线学习框架来进行网络自动化。
AI.method: inRAN框架的核心思想是集成可解释的代理模型和安全的优化求解器，以持续优化控制动作，同时适应真实网络中的非平稳动态。该框架包含三个关键组件：1) 通过集成Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）实现的可解释代理模型；2) 通过集成遗传搜索和信赖域下降方法实现的安全优化求解器；3) 通过持续模型学习和自适应阈值偏移实现的在线动态跟踪器。
AI.result: 在端到端的O-RAN兼容网络测试台中，针对网络切片的重点应用场景进行了广泛的空中实验。结果表明，inRAN在保证机会约束方面表现出色，保证率为92.67%，同时在在线网络控制中保持了可比的资源使用率。
AI.conclusion: inRAN在在线网络控制中，在不可预见的、随时间变化的网络动态下，以92.67%的保证率保证了基于机会的约束，并且资源使用率与现有最先进方法相当，性能显著优于现有技术。
AI.translation: 新兴的人工智能/机器学习技术在开放无线接入网（Open RAN）的网络控制自动化方面显示出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法严重依赖于由深度神经网络参数化的黑盒策略，这些策略本质上缺乏可解释性、可解释性和透明度，给实际网络部署带来了巨大障碍。在本文中，我们提出了inRAN，一个新颖的可解释在线贝叶斯学习框架，用于Open RAN中的网络自动化。其核心思想是集成可解释的代理模型和安全的优化求解器，以持续优化控制动作，同时适应真实网络中的非平稳动态。我们通过三个关键组件实现了inRAN框架：1) 通过集成Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）的可解释代理模型；2) 通过集成遗传搜索和信赖域下降方法实现的安全性优化求解器；3) 通过持续模型学习和自适应阈值偏移实现的在线动态跟踪器。我们在端到端的O-RAN兼容网络测试台中实现了inRAN，并针对网络切片的重点应用场景进行了广泛的空中实验。结果表明，在不可预见的、随时间变化的网络动态下，inRAN在保证机会约束方面取得了92.67%的保证率，并且在整个在线网络控制过程中保持了可比的资源使用率，从而显著优于最先进的工作。
AI.summary: inRAN是一个新颖的可解释在线贝叶斯学习框架，旨在解决Open RAN网络自动化中现有黑盒AI方法缺乏可解释性的问题。该框架通过集成基于KANs的可解释代理模型、安全优化求解器以及在线动态跟踪器，以持续优化控制动作并适应非平稳网络动态。实验证明，inRAN在网络切片场景下，以高保证率满足约束条件，性能优于现有最先进方法。
AI.keywords: Open RAN, 在线学习, 可解释性, 贝叶斯学习, 网络自动化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个结合可解释模型（KANs）和安全优化求解器的在线贝叶斯学习框架（inRAN），解决了现有黑盒AI方法在Open RAN部署中的可解释性难题。其重要性在于为实际网络自动化提供了透明、可靠的决策机制。局限性在于实验集中在网络切片这一特定用例上。

title: From Entropy to Epiplexity: Rethinking Information for Computationally Bounded Intelligence
summary: Can we learn more from data than existed in the generating process itself? Can new and useful information be constructed from merely applying deterministic transformations to existing data? Can the learnable content in data be evaluated without considering a downstream task? On these questions, Shannon information and Kolmogorov complexity come up nearly empty-handed, in part because they assume observers with unlimited computational capacity and fail to target the useful information content. In this work, we identify and exemplify three seeming paradoxes in information theory: (1) information cannot be increased by deterministic transformations; (2) information is independent of the order of data; (3) likelihood modeling is merely distribution matching. To shed light on the tension between these results and modern practice, and to quantify the value of data, we introduce epiplexity, a formalization of information capturing what computationally bounded observers can learn from data. Epiplexity captures the structural content in data while excluding time-bounded entropy, the random unpredictable content exemplified by pseudorandom number generators and chaotic dynamical systems. With these concepts, we demonstrate how information can be created with computation, how it depends on the ordering of the data, and how likelihood modeling can produce more complex programs than present in the data generating process itself. We also present practical procedures to estimate epiplexity which we show capture differences across data sources, track with downstream performance, and highlight dataset interventions that improve out-of-distribution generalization. In contrast to principles of model selection, epiplexity provides a theoretical foundation for data selection, guiding how to select, generate, or transform data for learning systems.

AI.title_translation: 从熵到环绕性：为计算受限智能重新思考信息
AI.tldr: 传统信息论对AI无用，因为它假设无限计算能力。本文提出了“环绕性”来衡量计算受限AI能从数据中学到多少真正有用的结构信息，而不是随机噪音。环绕性表明信息可以通过计算生成，并指导我们如何选择最佳数据进行训练。
AI.motivation: 传统的信息论度量（香农信息和柯氏复杂度）假设观察者具有无限的计算能力，并且未能针对有用的信息内容，这使得它们无法解释现代计算实践中信息如何被构造和利用的现象。需要一种新的信息度量来量化计算受限观察者从数据中获取的价值。
AI.method: 引入“环绕性”（epiplexity）作为信息的新形式化定义，用于捕捉计算受限观察者能从数据中学到的结构性内容，并将其与时间受限的熵（如伪随机数生成器中的随机不可预测内容）区分开来。提出了估计环绕性的实践程序。
AI.result: 证明了信息可以通过计算被创造出来；信息依赖于数据的排序；似然模型可以产生比数据生成过程本身更复杂的程序。提出的估计环绕性的程序能够区分不同数据源，与下游性能相关，并突出能改善分布外泛化的数据集干预措施。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入环绕性（epiplexity），我们证明了信息可以通过计算来创造，信息依赖于数据的排序，并且似然模型可以产生比数据生成过程本身更复杂的程序。环绕性为数据选择提供了理论基础，指导如何选择、生成或转换数据以用于学习系统。
AI.translation: 我们能从比生成过程本身存在的数据中学到更多吗？仅通过对现有数据应用确定性变换，能否构建出新的有用信息？在不考虑下游任务的情况下，能否评估数据中可学习的内容？在这些问题上，香农信息和柯氏复杂度几乎无能为力，部分原因在于它们假设观察者具有无限的计算能力，并且未能针对有用的信息内容。在工作中，我们识别并举例说明了信息论中的三个看似矛盾的现象：（1）信息不能通过确定性变换来增加；（2）信息与数据的顺序无关；（3）似然建模仅仅是分布匹配。为了阐明这些结果与现代实践之间的张力，并量化数据的价值，我们引入了环绕性（epiplexity），这是对信息的一种形式化，用于捕捉计算受限的观察者能从数据中学到的内容。环绕性捕捉了数据中的结构内容，同时排除了时间受限的熵（例如由伪随机数生成器和混沌动力系统所例证的随机不可预测内容）。有了这些概念，我们证明了信息如何通过计算产生，它如何依赖于数据的排序，以及似然建模如何能产生比数据生成过程本身存在的更复杂的程序。我们还提出了估计环绕性的实践程序，我们证明这些程序能够捕捉不同数据源之间的差异，与下游性能保持一致，并突出能改善分布外泛化的数据集干预措施。与模型选择的原则相反，环绕性为数据选择提供了理论基础，指导如何选择、生成或转换数据以用于学习系统。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统信息论无法解释计算受限智能体如何从数据中学习的局限性，引入了“环绕性”（Epiplexity）这一新概念。环绕性形式化了计算受限观察者能从数据中学到的结构性信息内容，排除了随机不可预测的内容。研究表明，信息可以被计算创造，且依赖于数据顺序，并为数据选择提供了理论指导。
AI.keywords: 计算受限智能, 信息论, 环绕性, 数据选择, 柯氏复杂度
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了“Epiplexity”这一新概念，旨在解决传统信息论（如香农信息和柯氏复杂度）在处理计算受限智能体时的局限性。它通过量化计算受限观察者能从数据中学到的内容，为数据选择提供了理论基础，这在深度学习和实际AI应用中具有重要意义。局限性在于，摘要中只提到了“实践程序来估计环绕性”，但没有详细说明这些估计方法的有效性和具体细节。

title: The Fake Friend Dilemma: Trust and the Political Economy of Conversational AI
summary: As conversational AI systems become increasingly integrated into everyday life, they raise pressing concerns about user autonomy, trust, and the commercial interests that influence their behavior. To address these concerns, this paper develops the Fake Friend Dilemma (FFD), a sociotechnical condition in which users place trust in AI agents that appear supportive while pursuing goals that are misaligned with the user's own. The FFD provides a critical framework for examining how anthropomorphic AI systems facilitate subtle forms of manipulation and exploitation. Drawing on literature in trust, AI alignment, and surveillance capitalism, we construct a typology of harms, including covert advertising, political propaganda, behavioral nudging, and surveillance. We then assess possible mitigation strategies, including both structural and technical interventions. By focusing on trust as a vector of asymmetrical power, the FFD offers a lens for understanding how AI systems may undermine user autonomy while maintaining the appearance of helpfulness.

AI.title_translation: 虚假朋友困境：对话式AI的信任与政治经济学
AI.tldr: AI系统看起来像朋友，但其实在为商业利益服务，这被称为“虚假朋友困境”（FFD）。论文分析了这种信任如何被利用（如广告、宣传）来损害用户，并提出了一些解决办法。
AI.motivation: 对话式AI系统日益融入日常生活，引发了关于用户自主权、信任以及影响其行为的商业利益的紧迫担忧。
AI.method: 构建了“虚假朋友困境”（FFD）这一社会技术条件，并借鉴了信任、AI对齐和监控资本主义的文献，构建了一个危害类型学，并评估了结构性和技术性干预措施。
AI.result: 构建了一个危害类型学，包括隐蔽广告、政治宣传、行为助推和监控。同时评估了包括结构性和技术性干预在内的潜在缓解策略。
AI.conclusion: 该论文通过FFD提供了一个理解AI系统如何在维持有益表象的同时损害用户自主权的新视角，重点关注信任作为一种不对称权力的载体。
AI.translation: 随着对话式人工智能系统日益融入日常生活，它们引发了关于用户自主权、信任以及影响其行为的商业利益的紧迫担忧。为解决这些担忧，本文提出了“虚假朋友困境”（FFD），这是一种社会技术条件，即用户信任那些表面上提供支持，但实际上追求与用户自身目标不一致目标的AI代理。FFD提供了一个批判性框架，用于审查拟人化AI系统如何促进微妙的操纵和剥削形式。借鉴了信任、AI对齐和监控资本主义的文献，我们构建了一个危害的类型学，包括隐蔽广告、政治宣传、行为助推和监控。然后我们评估了可能的缓解策略，包括结构性和技术性干预。通过关注信任作为不对称权力的载体，FFD提供了一个理解AI系统如何在保持有益性的表象下破坏用户自主权的新视角。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“虚假朋友困境”（FFD）这一概念，用以分析用户信任的拟人化AI系统如何追求与用户目标不一致的商业利益，从而导致微妙的操纵和剥削。文章基于相关文献构建了危害类型学，并探讨了缓解策略，强调了信任在AI系统中心不对称权力中的作用。
AI.keywords: 虚假朋友困境, 信任, 政治经济学, 拟人化AI, 用户自主权
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了“虚假朋友困境”（FFD）这一新的社会技术框架，用以批判性地分析拟人化AI如何利用用户信任进行微妙的操纵和剥削。其重要性在于揭示了AI系统在保持“有用性”表象下，如何服务于商业利益并损害用户自主权。局限性在于，它主要集中于理论框架的构建和危害的分类，具体的缓解策略可能需要更深入的实证检验。

title: Are eHMIs always helpful? Investigating how eHMIs interfere with pedestrian behavior on multi-lane streets: An eye-tracking virtual reality experiment
summary: Appropriate communication is crucial for efficient and safe interactions between pedestrians and autonomous vehicles (AVs). External human-machine interfaces (eHMIs) on AVs, which can be categorized as allocentric or egocentric, are considered a promising solution. While the effectiveness of eHMIs has been extensively studied, in complex environments, such as unsignalized multi-lane streets, their potential to interfere with pedestrian crossing behavior remains underexplored. Hence, a virtual reality-based experiment was conducted to examine how different types of eHMIs displayed on AVs affect the crossing behavior of pedestrians in multi-lane streets environments, with a focus on the gaze patterns of pedestrians during crossing. The results revealed that the presence of eHMIs significantly influenced the cognitive load on pedestrians and increased the possibility of distraction, even misleading pedestrians in cases involving multiple AVs on multi-lane streets. Notably, allocentric eHMIs induced higher cognitive loads and greater distraction in pedestrians than egocentric eHMIs. This was primarily evidenced by longer gaze time and higher proportions of attention for the eHMI on the interacting vehicle, as well as a broader distribution of gaze toward vehicles in the non-interacting lane. However, misleading behavior was mainly triggered by eHMI signals from yielding vehicles in the non-interacting lane. Under such asymmetric signal configurations, egocentric eHMIs resulted in a higher misjudgment rate than allocentric eHMIs. These findings highlight the importance of enhancing eHMI designs to balance the clarity and consistency of the displayed information across different perspectives, especially in complex multi-lane traffic scenarios. This study provides valuable insights regarding the application and standardization of future eHMI systems for AVs.

AI.title_translation: eHMI总是有效吗？研究电子人机界面如何干扰多车道街道上行人的行为：一项眼动追踪虚拟现实实验
AI.tldr: 研究发现，自动驾驶汽车上的外部人机界面（eHMI）在复杂的街道环境中可能会分散行人的注意力甚至误导其行为，分配中心式eHMI带来的认知负担更大，但在特定情况下，以自我为中心式eHMI更容易导致行人误判。设计时需权衡信息的清晰度和一致性。
AI.motivation: 虽然eHMI被认为是解决行人与自动驾驶汽车（AV）安全交互的潜在方案，但在复杂的非信号灯控制的多车道街道环境中，eHMI对行人过街行为的潜在干扰作用仍有待深入研究。
AI.method: 进行了一项基于虚拟现实（VR）的实验，旨在检验在多车道街道环境中，自动驾驶汽车上显示的eHMI类型（分配中心式或以自我为中心式）如何影响行人的过街行为，重点关注行人过街期间的注视模式。
AI.result: eHMI的存在显著影响了行人的认知负荷并增加了分心可能性，在多车道街道涉及多辆AV的情况下甚至可能误导行人。分配中心式eHMI比以自我为中心式eHMI引起了更高的认知负荷和更大的分心。然而，误导行为主要由非交互车道上让行的车辆的eHMI信号触发，在这种不对称信号配置下，以自我为中心式eHMI导致了更高的误判率。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了未来eHMI设计需要平衡信息清晰度和一致性的重要性，尤其是在复杂的多车道交通场景中，以期为未来自动驾驶汽车的eHMI系统的应用和标准化提供宝贵的见解。
AI.translation: 恰当的沟通对于行人和自动驾驶汽车（AV）之间高效和安全的交互至关重要。自动驾驶汽车上的外部人机界面（eHMI），可分为分配中心式或以自我为中心式，被认为是一种有前景的解决方案。尽管eHMI的有效性已被广泛研究，但在复杂的环境中，如无信号灯控制的多车道街道，其对行人过街行为的潜在干扰作用仍有待深入探索。因此，进行了一项基于虚拟现实的实验，以检验在多车道街道环境中，自动驾驶汽车上显示的**不同类型eHMI**如何影响行人的过街行为，重点关注行人过街期间的注视模式。结果显示，eHMI的存在显著影响了行人的认知负荷并增加了分心的可能性，在涉及多辆自动驾驶汽车的多车道街道情况下甚至会误导行人。值得注意的是，分配中心式eHMI比以自我为中心式eHMI引起了更高的认知负荷和更大的分心。这主要通过注视时间更长、对交互车辆的注意力比例更高，以及注视分布更分散到非交互车道上的车辆得到证明。然而，误导行为主要由非交互车道上让行的车辆的eHMI信号触发。在这种不对称信号配置下，以自我为中心式eHMI导致了比分配中心式eHMI更高的误判率。这些发现突显了增强eHMI设计的重要性，以平衡所显示信息在不同视角下的清晰度和一致性，尤其是在复杂的**多车道交通场景**中。本研究为未来自动驾驶汽车eHMI系统的应用和标准化提供了宝贵的见解。
AI.summary: 本研究通过VR眼动追踪实验，探究了外部人机界面（eHMI）在复杂多车道街道中对行人过街行为的影响。结果显示，eHMI会增加行人的认知负荷和分心，且分配中心式eHMI的干扰效应更强。特别是在信号不对称情况下，不同类型的eHMI可能导致不同的误判率，提示未来设计需注意信息清晰度和一致性。
AI.keywords: eHMI, 行人行为, 多车道街道, 虚拟现实, 眼动追踪
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于，它首次在复杂的非信号灯控制的多车道街道场景中，使用眼动追踪技术研究了不同类型的eHMI（分配中心式与以自我为中心式）对行人过街行为和认知负荷的具体干扰效应。研究结果提出了一个重要的反直觉观点：eHMI并非总是有效，在特定不对称信号配置下，它们可能导致行人误判。

title: Wait or cross? Understanding the influence of behavioral tendency, trust, and risk perception on pedestrian gap-acceptance of automated truck platoons
summary: Although automated trucks have the potential to improve freight efficiency, reduce costs, and address driver shortages, organizing two or more trucks in a convoy has raised considerable concerns for pedestrian safety. This study conducted a controlled experiment to examine the influence of behavioral tendency, trust, and risk perception on pedestrian intention to cross in front of an automated truck platoon. A total of 603 subjects participated in the virtual reality video-based questionnaire survey. By fusing the merits of structural equation modeling and artificial neural networks, a two-stage, hybrid model was developed to examine complex relationships between latent variables and gap-acceptance behaviors. Our results indicated that subjects watched an average of five vehicle gaps before starting crossing and the average time gap accepted was about 5.35 seconds. Risk perception not only played the most dominant role in shaping pedestrian crossing decisions, but also served as the strong bone, mediating the effects of behavioral tendency and trust on gap-acceptance. Participants who frequently violated traffic rules were more likely to accept a smaller time gap, while those who showed positive behaviors to other road users tended to wait for a larger time gap. Participants who often committed errors, showed aggressive behaviors, and held greater trust in the safety of automated trucks generally reported a lower level of risk for road-crossing in front of automated truck platoons. Built on these findings, a range of tailored countermeasures were proposed to ensure safer and smother interactions between pedestrians and automated truck platoons.

AI.title_translation: 等待还是穿越？理解行为倾向、信任和风险感知对行人穿越自动化卡车编队车辆间隙的影响
AI.tldr: 行人穿越自动化卡车编队时，风险感知是影响其决策的最主要因素，其次是行为倾向和信任。
AI.motivation: 为了解决自动驾驶卡车编队对行人安全造成的担忧，本研究旨在理解行为倾向、信任和风险感知如何影响行人穿越卡车编队的意图。
AI.method: 通过虚拟现实视频问卷调查，收集了603名参与者的数据，并采用结构方程模型和人工神经网络相结合的两阶段混合模型来分析潜在变量与间隙接受行为之间的复杂关系。
AI.result: 行人平均在观察了五个车辆间隙后开始穿越，可接受的平均时间间隙约为5.35秒。风险感知是影响行人穿越决策的最主要因素，并调节了行为倾向和信任对间隙接受行为的影响。频繁违反交通规则的行人倾向于接受更小的时间间隙，而对其他道路使用者表现出积极行为的行人则倾向于等待更大的时间间隙。经常犯错、表现出攻击性行为以及对自动驾驶卡车安全性有较高信任度的行人，普遍认为在卡车编队前穿越的风险较低。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为制定旨在确保行人与自动驾驶卡车编队之间更安全、更顺畅交互的定制化应对措施提供了依据。
AI.translation: 尽管自动驾驶卡车有潜力提高货运效率、降低成本并解决司机短缺问题，但将两辆或多辆卡车组织成队列引起了对行人安全的极大担忧。本研究进行了对照实验，以检查行为倾向、信任和风险感知对行人穿越自动驾驶卡车编队意图的影响。共有603名受试者参与了虚拟现实视频问卷调查。通过融合结构方程模型和人工神经网络的优点，开发了一个两阶段的混合模型来检验潜在变量与间隙接受行为之间的复杂关系。我们的结果表明，受试者在开始穿越前平均观察了五个车辆间隙，可接受的平均时间间隙约为5.35秒。风险感知不仅在塑造行人穿越决策方面起着最主导的作用，而且作为坚实的骨架，调节了行为倾向和信任对间隙接受行为的影响。频繁违反交通规则的参与者更有可能接受较小的时间间隙，而对其他道路使用者表现出积极行为的参与者则倾向于等待较大的时间间隙。经常犯错、表现出攻击性行为以及对自动驾驶卡车安全性有较高信任度的参与者，普遍认为在自动驾驶卡车编队前穿越的风险水平较低。基于这些发现，提出了一系列定制化的应对措施，以确保行人与自动驾驶卡车编队之间更安全、更顺畅的交互。
AI.summary: 本研究利用虚拟现实技术和混合模型，探究了行为倾向、信任和风险感知对行人穿越自动驾驶卡车编队时机选择的影响。研究发现，风险感知是决定行人是否穿越的最关键因素，它还调节了行为倾向和信任的作用。此外，行人的交通违规习惯、攻击性以及对自动驾驶卡车的信任度也与其风险评估和穿越决策相关。基于这些发现，研究提出了相应的安全建议。
AI.keywords: 行人安全, 自动驾驶卡车编队, 风险感知, 行为倾向, 间隙接受
AI.comments: 该研究通过结合虚拟现实实验和先进的混合建模方法，为理解行人与新兴的自动驾驶卡车编队之间的交互行为提供了有价值的见解。研究结果强调了风险感知在行人决策中的核心作用，并揭示了行为倾向和信任的间接影响。然而，实验的虚拟现实环境可能无法完全模拟真实世界的复杂性，未来的研究可以考虑在更真实的场景中进行验证。研究提出的针对性干预措施为提高道路安全提供了实际指导。

title: The Sonar Moment: Benchmarking Audio-Language Models in Audio Geo-Localization
summary: Geo-localization aims to infer the geographic origin of a given signal. In computer vision, geo-localization has served as a demanding benchmark for compositional reasoning and is relevant to public safety. In contrast, progress on audio geo-localization has been constrained by the lack of high-quality audio-location pairs. To address this gap, we introduce AGL1K, the first audio geo-localization benchmark for audio language models (ALMs), spanning 72 countries and territories. To extract reliably localizable samples from a crowd-sourced platform, we propose the Audio Localizability metric that quantifies the informativeness of each recording, yielding 1,444 curated audio clips. Evaluations on 16 ALMs show that ALMs have emerged with audio geo-localization capability. We find that closed-source models substantially outperform open-source models, and that linguistic clues often dominate as a scaffold for prediction. We further analyze ALMs' reasoning traces, regional bias, error causes, and the interpretability of the localizability metric. Overall, AGL1K establishes a benchmark for audio geo-localization and may advance ALMs with better geospatial reasoning capability.

AI.title_translation: 音频时刻：音频语言模型在音频地理定位方面的基准测试
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了AGL1K，一个包含1444个音频片段、覆盖72个国家和地区的音频地理定位基准数据集，用于评估音频语言模型（ALMs）。实验表明，ALMs已具备音频地理定位能力，但闭源模型表现优于开源模型，且语言线索在预测中起主导作用。研究还分析了ALMs的推理过程、区域偏见、错误原因和可解释性，旨在推动ALMs在地理空间推理方面的发展。
AI.motivation: 现有音频地理定位研究受限于高质量音频-位置对的缺乏，阻碍了相关进展。
AI.method: 引入AGL1K数据集，包含1444个精心挑选的音频片段，覆盖72个国家和地区，并提出音频可定位性度量指标来量化录音的信息量。在16个ALMs上进行评估。
AI.result: ALMs已展现出音频地理定位能力，闭源模型显著优于开源模型，语言线索在预测中起重要作用。研究还分析了ALMs的推理痕迹、区域偏见、错误原因和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: AGL1K数据集为音频地理定位设定了基准，并有望提升ALMs的地理空间推理能力。
AI.translation: 地理定位旨在推断给定信号的地理来源。在计算机视觉领域，地理定位一直是检验组合推理能力的严峻基准，并与公共安全相关。相比之下，音频地理定位的进展受限于高质量音频-位置对的缺乏。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了AGL1K，这是第一个针对音频语言模型（ALMs）的音频地理定位基准，覆盖72个国家和地区。为了从众包平台提取可靠可定位的样本，我们提出了音频可定位性度量，量化了每个录音的信息量，产生了1444个精选的音频片段。在16个ALMs上的评估表明，ALMs已具备音频地理定位能力。我们发现闭源模型显著优于开源模型，并且语言线索通常在预测中起主导作用。我们进一步分析了ALMs的推理痕迹、区域偏见、错误原因以及可定位性度量的可解释性。总的来说，AGL1K为音频地理定位建立了基准，并可能通过更好的地理空间推理能力来推进ALMs。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了AGL1K，一个新提出的音频地理定位基准数据集，旨在解决现有音频地理定位研究中高质量数据对的不足问题。该数据集包含1444个经过筛选的音频片段，覆盖全球72个国家和地区，并引入了音频可定位性度量来评估录音的信息价值。通过在16个音频语言模型（ALMs）上的评估，研究发现ALMs已具备音频地理定位能力，但闭源模型表现优于开源模型，且语言线索在预测过程中扮演关键角色。此外，研究还深入分析了模型的推理过程、潜在的区域偏见以及错误成因，为未来ALMs在地理空间推理能力上的发展奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 音频地理定位, 音频语言模型, AGL1K数据集, 音频可定位性, 地理空间推理
AI.comments: 该研究在音频地理定位领域做出了重要贡献，通过构建AGL1K这一大规模、高质量的基准数据集，为评估和推动音频语言模型（ALMs）在该任务上的发展提供了坚实的基础。研究结果揭示了当前ALMs在音频地理定位方面的能力，特别是闭源模型相对于开源模型的优势，以及语言线索在预测中的关键作用，这些发现对于理解和改进ALMs的地理空间推理能力具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，研究也存在一些局限性，例如AGL1K数据集的构建依赖于众包平台，可能存在一定的噪声和偏差，并且对“语言线索”的依赖性分析有待进一步深入探讨。未来的研究可以关注如何提升开源模型的性能，以及更精细化地利用音频内容本身进行地理定位，而非仅仅依赖语言信息。

title: SpANNS: Optimizing Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search for Sparse Vectors Using Near Memory Processing
summary: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) is a fundamental operation in vector databases, enabling efficient similarity search in high-dimensional spaces. While dense ANNS has been optimized using specialized hardware accelerators, sparse ANNS remains limited by CPU-based implementations, hindering scalability. This limitation is increasingly critical as hybrid retrieval systems, combining sparse and dense embeddings, become standard in Information Retrieval (IR) pipelines. We propose SpANNS, a near-memory processing architecture for sparse ANNS. SpANNS combines a hybrid inverted index with efficient query management and runtime optimizations. The architecture is built on a CXL Type-2 near-memory platform, where a specialized controller manages query parsing and cluster filtering, while compute-enabled DIMMs perform index traversal and distance computations close to the data. It achieves 15.2x to 21.6x faster execution over the state-of-the-art CPU baselines, offering scalable and efficient solutions for sparse vector search.

AI.title_translation: SpANNS：利用近存处理优化稀疏向量的近似最近邻搜索
AI.tldr: 为解决CPU上稀疏ANNS效率低下的问题，研究人员提出了SpANNS，一个利用CXL Type-2近存处理架构的系统，它将索引和计算移到靠近数据的位置，使稀疏向量搜索速度比现有CPU方法快15倍以上。
AI.motivation: 稀疏ANNS的性能受限于基于CPU的实现，这阻碍了包含稀疏和密集嵌入的混合检索系统的可扩展性，而这种系统正成为信息检索管道的标准。
AI.method: SpANNS提出了一种基于CXL Type-2近存平台的架构。它结合了混合倒排索引、高效的查询管理和运行时优化。一个专门的控制器负责查询解析和集群过滤，而具备计算能力的DIMM则在数据附近执行索引遍历和距离计算。
AI.result: 与最先进的CPU基线相比，SpANNS实现了15.2倍到21.6倍更快的执行速度。
AI.conclusion: SpANNS提供了一种可扩展且高效的稀疏向量搜索解决方案，通过在CXL Type-2近存平台上实现混合倒排索引和计算卸载，显著提升了性能。
AI.translation: 近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）是向量数据库中的一项基本操作，它能够在高维空间中实现高效的相似性搜索。尽管密集ANNS已经利用专业硬件加速器进行了优化，但稀疏ANNS仍然受限于基于CPU的实现，阻碍了其可扩展性。这种限制在结合稀疏和密集嵌入的混合检索系统成为信息检索（IR）管道标准之际变得日益关键。我们提出了SpANNS，一个用于稀疏ANNS的近存处理架构。SpANNS结合了混合倒排索引、高效的查询管理和运行时优化。该架构建立在CXL Type-2近存平台上，其中一个专用控制器管理查询解析和集群过滤，而具备计算能力的DIMM则在靠近数据的位置执行索引遍历和距离计算。与最先进的CPU基线相比，它实现了15.2倍到21.6倍更快的执行速度，为稀疏向量搜索提供了可扩展且高效的解决方案。
AI.summary: SpANNS是一种针对稀疏向量近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）的近存处理（NMP）架构，旨在解决现有CPU实现对混合检索系统的性能限制。该架构基于CXL Type-2平台，集成了混合倒排索引和计算卸载（在DIMM上执行索引遍历和距离计算），从而实现了比现有CPU基线快15.2倍至21.6倍的执行效率。
AI.keywords: 近似最近邻搜索, 稀疏向量, 近存处理, CXL, 混合检索
AI.comments: SpANNS的创新在于首次将近存处理（NMP）应用于稀疏向量的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS），解决了现有CPU实现的性能瓶颈。其重要性在于支持日益普及的混合检索系统。局限性方面，该分析仅基于摘要，未涉及具体硬件细节或与最先进的稀疏ANNS方法的全面对比。

title: Multi-RADS Synthetic Radiology Report Dataset and Head-to-Head Benchmarking of 41 Open-Weight and Proprietary Language Models
summary: Background: Reporting and Data Systems (RADS) standardize radiology risk communication but automated RADS assignment from narrative reports is challenging because of guideline complexity, output-format constraints, and limited benchmarking across RADS frameworks and model sizes. Purpose: To create RXL-RADSet, a radiologist-verified synthetic multi-RADS benchmark, and compare validity and accuracy of open-weight small language models (SLMs) with a proprietary model for RADS assignment. Materials and Methods: RXL-RADSet contains 1,600 synthetic radiology reports across 10 RADS (BI-RADS, CAD-RADS, GB-RADS, LI-RADS, Lung-RADS, NI-RADS, O-RADS, PI-RADS, TI-RADS, VI-RADS) and multiple modalities. Reports were generated by LLMs using scenario plans and simulated radiologist styles and underwent two-stage radiologist verification. We evaluated 41 quantized SLMs (12 families, 0.135-32B parameters) and GPT-5.2 under a fixed guided prompt. Primary endpoints were validity and accuracy; a secondary analysis compared guided versus zero-shot prompting. Results: Under guided prompting GPT-5.2 achieved 99.8% validity and 81.1% accuracy (1,600 predictions). Pooled SLMs (65,600 predictions) achieved 96.8% validity and 61.1% accuracy; top SLMs in the 20-32B range reached ~99% validity and mid-to-high 70% accuracy. Performance scaled with model size (inflection between <1B and >=10B) and declined with RADS complexity primarily due to classification difficulty rather than invalid outputs. Guided prompting improved validity (99.2% vs 96.7%) and accuracy (78.5% vs 69.6%) compared with zero-shot. Conclusion: RXL-RADSet provides a radiologist-verified multi-RADS benchmark; large SLMs (20-32B) can approach proprietary-model performance under guided prompting, but gaps remain for higher-complexity schemes.

AI.title_translation: 多RADS合成放射学报告数据集以及41个开放权重和专有语言模型的头对头基准测试
AI.tldr: 该研究创建了一个名为RXL-RADSet的合成多RADS报告数据集，并评估了41个小型语言模型（SLM）和一个专有模型（GPT-5.2）在RADS分配方面的性能。结果显示，在引导提示下，GPT-5.2表现最佳，而大型SLM（20-32B参数）的性能接近专有模型，但仍存在差距，尤其是在处理复杂RADS分类时。引导提示比零样本提示更能提高模型性能。
AI.motivation: 自动化RADS分配面临挑战，因为指南复杂、输出格式受限，并且缺乏跨RADS框架和模型规模的基准测试。
AI.method: 创建了一个名为RXL-RADSet的合成多RADS基准数据集，包含1600份经过放射科医生验证的合成报告，涵盖10种RADS和多种成像模式。使用LLM生成报告，并由放射科医生进行两阶段验证。评估了41个量化SLM（0.135-32B参数）和GPT-5.2在固定引导提示下的有效性和准确性，并比较了引导提示与零样本提示的效果。
AI.result: 在引导提示下，GPT-5.2达到了99.8%的有效性和81.1%的准确性。所有SLM的综合有效性为96.8%，准确性为61.1%。20-32B参数范围内的顶级SLM有效性达到约99%，准确性在中高70%的范围。性能随模型规模增大而提升（在<1B和>=10B之间存在转折点），并因分类难度而非无效输出来降低。引导提示比零样本提示提高了有效性（99.2% vs 96.7%）和准确性（78.5% vs 69.6%）。
AI.conclusion: RXL-RADSet提供了一个经过放射科医生验证的多RADS基准。大型SLM（20-32B）在引导提示下可以接近专有模型的性能，但在处理更复杂的RADS分类方案时仍存在差距。
AI.translation: 背景：报告和数据系统（RADS）标准化放射风险沟通，但由于指南的复杂性、输出格式的限制以及跨RADS框架和模型规模的有限基准测试，从叙述性报告中自动分配RADS具有挑战性。目的：创建RXL-RADSet，一个放射科医生验证的多RADS合成基准，并比较开放权重小型语言模型（SLM）与专有模型在RADS分配方面的有效性和准确性。材料与方法：RXL-RADSet包含1600份跨10个RADS（BI-RADS、CAD-RADS、GB-RADS、LI-RADS、Lung-RADS、NI-RADS、O-RADS、PI-RADS、TI-RADS、VI-RADS）和多种成像模式的合成放射学报告。报告由LLM使用场景计划和模拟放射科医生风格生成，并经过两阶段放射科医生验证。我们评估了41个量化SLM（12个家族，0.135-32B参数）和GPT-5.2在固定引导提示下的表现。主要终点是有效性和准确性；次要分析比较了引导提示与零样本提示。结果：在引导提示下，GPT-5.2达到了99.8%的有效性和81.1%的准确性（1600次预测）。综合SLM（65,600次预测）达到了96.8%的有效性和61.1%的准确性；20-32B范围内的顶级SLM达到了约99%的有效性和中高70%的准确性。性能随模型规模增大而扩展（在<1B和>=10B之间存在转折点），并主要由于分类难度而非无效输出而随RADS复杂性下降。引导提示比零样本提示提高了有效性（99.2% vs 96.7%）和准确性（78.5% vs 69.6%）。结论：RXL-RADSet提供了一个放射科医生验证的多RADS基准；大型SLM（20-32B）在引导提示下可以接近专有模型的性能，但对于更高复杂性的方案仍存在差距。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了RXL-RADSet，一个包含1600份合成放射学报告的多RADS基准数据集，并对41个开放权重小型语言模型（SLM）和GPT-5.2进行了评估。结果表明，在引导提示下，GPT-5.2表现最优，而大型SLM（20-32B）的性能接近专有模型，但仍有提升空间，特别是在处理复杂RADS分类时。引导提示显著优于零样本提示。
AI.keywords: RADS分配,小型语言模型,合成数据集,基准测试,放射学报告
AI.comments: 该研究创建了一个有价值的多RADS数据集，解决了自动化RADS分配中的一个关键挑战。通过对大量模型进行基准测试，提供了关于不同模型规模和类型在这一任务上性能的宝贵见解。然而，模型性能与RADS复杂性的关系以及大型SLM与专有模型之间的差距，为未来的研究提供了明确的方向。

title: LTX-2: Efficient Joint Audio-Visual Foundation Model
summary: Recent text-to-video diffusion models can generate compelling video sequences, yet they remain silent -- missing the semantic, emotional, and atmospheric cues that audio provides. We introduce LTX-2, an open-source foundational model capable of generating high-quality, temporally synchronized audiovisual content in a unified manner. LTX-2 consists of an asymmetric dual-stream transformer with a 14B-parameter video stream and a 5B-parameter audio stream, coupled through bidirectional audio-video cross-attention layers with temporal positional embeddings and cross-modality AdaLN for shared timestep conditioning. This architecture enables efficient training and inference of a unified audiovisual model while allocating more capacity for video generation than audio generation. We employ a multilingual text encoder for broader prompt understanding and introduce a modality-aware classifier-free guidance (modality-CFG) mechanism for improved audiovisual alignment and controllability. Beyond generating speech, LTX-2 produces rich, coherent audio tracks that follow the characters, environment, style, and emotion of each scene -- complete with natural background and foley elements. In our evaluations, the model achieves state-of-the-art audiovisual quality and prompt adherence among open-source systems, while delivering results comparable to proprietary models at a fraction of their computational cost and inference time. All model weights and code are publicly released.

AI.title_translation: LTX-2：高效的联合视听基础模型
AI.tldr: LTX-2是一个开源的视听模型，可以生成高质量、同步的视听内容。它使用一个不对称的双流Transformer架构，并结合了跨模态注意力机制，以实现高效的训练和推理。该模型在生成与视频内容匹配的音频方面表现出色，并达到了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到视频生成模型无法生成音频，忽略了音频在语义、情感和氛围方面提供的信息。
AI.method: LTX-2采用了一个不对称的双流Transformer架构，包含一个14B参数的视频流和一个5B参数的音频流。通过双向音视频交叉注意力层、时间位置嵌入以及跨模态AdaLN实现联合训练和推理。此外，还使用了多语言文本编码器和一种模态感知分类器自由引导（modality-CFG）机制。
AI.result: LTX-2在视听质量和提示遵循度方面达到了开源系统中的最先进水平，并且在计算成本和推理时间方面与专有模型相当。
AI.conclusion: LTX-2是一个高效的联合视听基础模型，能够生成高质量、时间同步的视听内容，并在性能和效率方面优于现有系统。
AI.translation: 近期文本到视频扩散模型能够生成引人注目的视频序列，但它们仍然是无声的——缺失了音频提供的语义、情感和氛围线索。我们引入了LTX-2，一个开源的基础模型，能够以统一的方式生成高质量、时间同步的视听内容。LTX-2由一个不对称的双流Transformer组成，包含一个14B参数的视频流和一个5B参数的音频流，通过具有时间位置嵌入的双向音视频交叉注意力层和用于共享时间步条件化的跨模态AdaLN耦合。该架构能够实现统一视听模型的有效训练和推理，同时为视频生成分配比音频生成更多的容量。我们采用多语言文本编码器以获得更广泛的提示理解，并引入模态感知分类器自由引导（modality-CFG）机制以改善视听对齐和可控性。除了生成语音，LTX-2还能生成丰富、连贯的音轨，这些音轨能够跟随每个场景的角色、环境、风格和情感——并配有自然的背景和音效元素。在我们的评估中，该模型在开源系统中的视听质量和提示遵循度方面达到了最先进水平，同时在计算成本和推理时间方面取得了与专有模型相当的结果。所有模型权重和代码均已公开发布。
AI.summary: LTX-2是一个创新的开源视听基础模型，它通过一个高效的双流Transformer架构解决了现有文本到视频模型缺乏音频的问题。该模型能够生成高质量、时间同步的视听内容，不仅包括视频，还包括与视频内容语义、情感和氛围高度匹配的音频。LTX-2通过其独特的架构设计，在训练和推理效率上表现出色，并在多个评估指标上达到了最先进的水平，甚至优于一些专有模型，同时保持了较低的计算成本。
AI.keywords: 视听生成, 基础模型, 文本到视频, Transformer, 跨模态学习
AI.comments: LTX-2在视听内容生成领域取得了显著进展，通过引入统一的视听基础模型解决了现有技术的局限性。其高效的双流架构和跨模态交互机制是该模型的关键创新点。然而，模型的泛化能力和在处理复杂、细微的情感表达方面的表现仍有待进一步探索。此外，对于模型在实际应用中的伦理考量和潜在滥用风险也需要关注。

title: MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents
summary: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends Large Language Models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches largely rely on semantic similarity over monolithic memory stores, entangling temporal, causal, and entity information. This design limits interpretability and alignment between query intent and retrieved evidence, leading to suboptimal reasoning accuracy. In this paper, we propose MAGMA, a multi-graph agentic memory architecture that represents each memory item across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal, and entity graphs. MAGMA formulates retrieval as policy-guided traversal over these relational views, enabling query-adaptive selection and structured context construction. By decoupling memory representation from retrieval logic, MAGMA provides transparent reasoning paths and fine-grained control over retrieval. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that MAGMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agentic memory systems in long-horizon reasoning tasks.

AI.title_translation: MAGMA：一种基于多图的智能体记忆架构
AI.tldr: 现有的AI内存系统将所有信息混在一起，导致推理不准确。MAGMA通过将内存分解成四个独立的图（语义、时间、因果、实体），并用策略引导遍历的方式来检索，实现了更清晰、更准确的长期推理。实验证明它比现有方法更好。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语义相似度的内存方法将时间、因果和实体信息混杂在一个单一的内存存储中，限制了可解释性和查询意图与检索证据之间的对齐，导致推理准确性不佳。
AI.method: 提出MAGMA，一个多图智能体内存架构，将每个内存项表示为正交的语义图、时间图、因果图和实体图。检索被表述为在这些关系视图上的策略引导遍历，以实现查询自适应的选择和结构化上下文构建。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval实验中，MAGMA一致地超越了最先进的智能体内存系统在长期推理任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: MAGMA在长视界推理任务上一致优于最先进的智能体内存系统。
AI.translation: 内存增强生成（MAG）通过外部内存扩展了大型语言模型，以支持长上下文推理，但现有方法在很大程度上依赖于单一内存存储上的语义相似性，使得时间、因果和实体信息相互纠缠。这种设计限制了可解释性以及查询意图与检索证据之间的对齐，从而导致推理准确性不佳。在本文中，我们提出了MAGMA，一种多图智能体内存架构，它通过正交的语义图、时间图、因果图和实体图来表示每个内存项。MAGMA将检索表述为在这些关系视图上的策略引导遍历，从而实现查询自适应的选择和结构化上下文构建。通过将内存表示与检索逻辑解耦，MAGMA提供了透明的推理路径和对检索的细粒度控制。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验表明，MAGMA在长期推理任务上持续优于最先进的智能体内存系统。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MAGMA，一种新的多图智能体内存架构，用于解决现有内存增强方法中信息混杂的问题。MAGMA通过将内存分解为语义、时间、因果和实体图，并以策略引导遍历的方式进行检索，从而实现了查询自适应的上下文构建、透明的推理路径和精确的控制，并在长期推理基准测试中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 内存增强生成, 智能体内存, 多图架构, 长期推理, 检索
AI.comments: MAGMA的创新之处在于将内存信息分解为正交的语义、时间、因果和实体图，从而实现了查询自适应的检索和结构化上下文构建，极大地提高了可解释性和推理准确性。其重要性在于为解决现有内存增强生成模型中信息混杂的问题提供了一个新的、结构化的解决方案。限制方面，抽象中未提及其在资源消耗或特定类型任务上的局限性。

title: PET-TURTLE: Deep Unsupervised Support Vector Machines for Imbalanced Data Clusters
summary: Foundation vision, audio, and language models enable zero-shot performance on downstream tasks via their latent representations. Recently, unsupervised learning of data group structure with deep learning methods has gained popularity. TURTLE, a state of the art deep clustering algorithm, uncovers data labeling without supervision by alternating label and hyperplane updates, maximizing the hyperplane margin, in a similar fashion to support vector machines (SVMs). However, TURTLE assumes clusters are balanced; when data is imbalanced, it yields non-ideal hyperplanes that cause higher clustering error. We propose PET-TURTLE, which generalizes the cost function to handle imbalanced data distributions by a power law prior. Additionally, by introducing sparse logits in the labeling process, PET-TURTLE optimizes a simpler search space that in turn improves accuracy for balanced datasets. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that PET-TURTLE improves accuracy for imbalanced sources, prevents over-prediction of minority clusters, and enhances overall clustering.

AI.title_translation: PET-TURTLE：用于不平衡数据聚类的深度无监督支持向量机
AI.tldr: PET-TURTLE是TURTLE（一种基于SVM原理的深度聚类算法）的升级版，通过加入“幂律先验”和“稀疏Logits”来解决其在处理不平衡数据时表现不佳的问题，实验证明它能有效提高不平衡数据的聚类准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的最先进的深度聚类算法TURTLE假设簇是平衡的，当数据不平衡时，它会产生非理想的超平面，导致更高的聚类误差。因此，需要一种新的方法来处理不平衡数据分布下的聚类问题。
AI.method: PET-TURTLE通过将成本函数泛化以处理不平衡数据分布，具体方法是引入一个幂律先验（power law prior）。此外，它在标签过程中引入稀疏Logits，从而优化了一个更简单的搜索空间。该方法在原理上与支持向量机（SVM）类似，通过交替更新标签和超平面来最大化超平面间隔。
AI.result: PET-TURTLE提高了不平衡数据源的准确性，防止了对少数簇的过度预测，并增强了整体聚类性能。对于平衡数据集，引入稀疏Logits也提高了准确性。
AI.conclusion: PET-TURTLE在合成和真实数据上的实验表明，它提高了不平衡数据集的准确性，防止了对少数类簇的过度预测，并增强了整体聚类性能。
AI.translation: 基础的视觉、音频和语言模型通过其潜在表示能够在下游任务中实现零样本性能。最近，使用深度学习方法对数据组结构进行无监督学习变得越来越流行。TURTLE，一种最先进的深度聚类算法，以类似于支持向量机（SVM）的方式，通过交替更新标签和超平面，最大化超平面间隔，从而在没有监督的情况下发现数据标签。然而，TURTLE假设簇是平衡的；当数据不平衡时，它会产生非理想的超平面，导致更高的聚类误差。我们提出了PET-TURTLE，它通过幂律先验将成本函数推广到处理不平衡数据分布。此外，通过在标签过程中引入稀疏Logits，PET-TURTLE优化了一个更简单的搜索空间，从而提高了平衡数据集的准确性。在合成和真实数据上的实验表明，PET-TURTLE提高了不平衡源的准确性，防止了对少数簇的过度预测，并增强了整体聚类。
AI.summary: PET-TURTLE是一种对现有深度聚类算法TURTLE的改进，专门用于解决不平衡数据聚类问题。它通过引入幂律先验来修改成本函数以适应不平衡分布，并通过引入稀疏Logits简化了优化过程。实验证明，PET-TURTLE在不平衡数据上表现更优，同时也能提高平衡数据的性能。
AI.keywords: 深度聚类, 不平衡数据, 支持向量机, TURTLE, 幂律先验
AI.comments: PET-TURTLE的主要创新在于通过引入幂律先验（power law prior）和稀疏Logits，成功地将TURTLE算法扩展到处理不平衡数据聚类问题，解决了原始TURTLE算法对平衡性假设的局限性。其方法论上结合了深度学习的特征表示学习与SVM的优化思想，并针对不平衡性进行了改进。

title: On the Capacity Region of Individual Key Rates in Vector Linear Secure Aggregation
summary: We provide new insights into an open problem recently posed by Yuan-Sun [ISIT 2025], concerning the minimum individual key rate required in the vector linear secure aggregation problem. Consider a distributed system with $K$ users, where each user $k\in [K]$ holds a data stream $W_k$ and an individual key $Z_k$. A server aims to compute a linear function $\mathbf{F}[W_1;\ldots;W_K]$ without learning any information about another linear function $\mathbf{G}[W_1;\ldots;W_K]$, where $[W_1;\ldots;W_K]$ denotes the row stack of $W_1,\ldots,W_K$. The open problem is to determine the minimum required length of $Z_k$, denoted as $R_k$, $k\in [K]$. In this paper, we characterize a new achievable region for the rate tuple $(R_1,\ldots,R_K)$. The region is polyhedral, with vertices characterized by a binary rate assignment $(R_1,\ldots,R_K) = (\mathbf{1}(1 \in \mathcal{I}),\ldots,\mathbf{1}(K\in \mathcal{I}))$, where $\mathcal{I}\subseteq [K]$ satisfies the \textit{rank-increment condition}: $\mathrm{rank}\left(\bigl[\mathbf{F}_{\mathcal{I}};\mathbf{G}_{\mathcal{I}}\bigr]\right) =\mathrm{rank}\bigl(\mathbf{F}_{\mathcal{I}}\bigr)+N$. Here, $\mathbf{F}_\mathcal{I}$ and $\mathbf{G}_\mathcal{I}$ are the submatrices formed by the columns indexed by $\mathcal{I}$. Our results uncover the novel fact that it is not necessary for every user to hold a key, thereby strictly enlarging the best-known achievable region in the literature. Furthermore, we provide a converse analysis to demonstrate its optimality when minimizing the number of users that hold keys.

title: SLIM: Stealthy Low-Coverage Black-Box Watermarking via Latent-Space Confusion Zones
summary: Training data is a critical and often proprietary asset in Large Language Model (LLM) development, motivating the use of data watermarking to embed model-transferable signals for usage verification. We identify low coverage as a vital yet largely overlooked requirement for practicality, as individual data owners typically contribute only a minute fraction of massive training corpora. Prior methods fail to maintain stealthiness, verification feasibility, or robustness when only one or a few sequences can be modified. To address these limitations, we introduce SLIM, a framework enabling per-user data provenance verification under strict black-box access. SLIM leverages intrinsic LLM properties to induce a Latent-Space Confusion Zone by training the model to map semantically similar prefixes to divergent continuations. This manifests as localized generation instability, which can be reliably detected via hypothesis testing. Experiments demonstrate that SLIM achieves ultra-low coverage capability, strong black-box verification performance, and great scalability while preserving both stealthiness and model utility, offering a robust solution for protecting training data in modern LLM pipelines.

title: $\mathsf{QAC}^0$ Contains $\mathsf{TC}^0$ (with Many Copies of the Input)
summary:
$\mathsf{QAC}^0$ is the class of constant-depth polynomial-size quantum circuits constructed from arbitrary single-qubit gates and generalized Toffoli gates. It is arguably the smallest natural class of constant-depth quantum computation which has not been shown useful for computing any non-trivial Boolean function. Despite this, many attempts to port classical $\mathsf{AC}^0$ lower bounds to $\mathsf{QAC}^0$ have failed.
  We give one possible explanation of this: $\mathsf{QAC}^0$ circuits are significantly more powerful than their classical counterparts. We show the unconditional separation $\mathsf{QAC}^0\not\subset\mathsf{AC}^0[p]$ for decision problems, which also resolves for the first time whether $\mathsf{AC}^0$ could be more powerful than $\mathsf{QAC}^0$. Moreover, we prove that $\mathsf{QAC}^0$ circuits can compute a wide range of Boolean functions if given multiple copies of the input: $\mathsf{TC}^0 \subseteq \mathsf{QAC}^0 \circ \mathsf{NC}^0$. Along the way, we introduce an amplitude amplification technique that makes several approximate constant-depth constructions exact.

title: STReasoner: Empowering LLMs for Spatio-Temporal Reasoning in Time Series via Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning
comments: preprint, we release our code publicly at https://github.com/LingFengGold/STReasoner
summary: Spatio-temporal reasoning in time series involves the explicit synthesis of temporal dynamics, spatial dependencies, and textual context. This capability is vital for high-stakes decision-making in systems such as traffic networks, power grids, and disease propagation. However, the field remains underdeveloped because most existing works prioritize predictive accuracy over reasoning. To address the gap, we introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark consisting of four core tasks, including etiological reasoning, entity identification, correlation reasoning, and in-context forecasting, developed via a network SDE-based multi-agent data synthesis pipeline. We then propose STReasoner, which empowers LLM to integrate time series, graph structure, and text for explicit reasoning. To promote spatially grounded logic, we introduce S-GRPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that rewards performance gains specifically attributable to spatial information. Experiments show that STReasoner achieves average accuracy gains between 17% and 135% at only 0.004X the cost of proprietary models and generalizes robustly to real-world data.
comment: preprint, we release our code publicly at https://github.com/LingFengGold/STReasoner

title: Proceedings 16th International Workshop on Graph Computation Models
summary:
This volume contains the post-proceedings of the Sixteenth International Workshop on Graph Computation Models (GCM 2025). The workshops took place in Koblenz, Germany on June 10 as part of STAF (Software Technologies: Applications and Foundations).  
  Graphs are common mathematical structures that are visual and intuitive. They constitute a natural and seamless way for system modeling in science, engineering, and beyond, including computer science, biology, and business process modeling. Graph computation models constitute a class of very high-level models where graphs are first-class citizens. The aim of the International GCM Workshop series is to bring together researchers interested in all aspects of computation models based on graphs and graph transformation. It promotes the cross-fertilizing exchange of ideas and experiences among senior and young researchers from the different communities interested in the foundations, applications, and implementations of graph computation models and related areas.

title: A Versatile Multimodal Agent for Multimedia Content Generation
summary: With the advancement of AIGC (AI-generated content) technologies, an increasing number of generative models are revolutionizing fields such as video editing, music generation, and even film production. However, due to the limitations of current AIGC models, most models can only serve as individual components within specific application scenarios and are not capable of completing tasks end-to-end in real-world applications. In real-world applications, editing experts often work with a wide variety of images and video inputs, producing multimodal outputs -- a video typically includes audio, text, and other elements. This level of integration across multiple modalities is something current models are unable to achieve effectively. However, the rise of agent-based systems has made it possible to use AI tools to tackle complex content generation tasks. To deal with the complex scenarios, in this paper, we propose a MultiMedia-Agent designed to automate complex content creation. Our agent system includes a data generation pipeline, a tool library for content creation, and a set of metrics for evaluating preference alignment. Notably, we introduce the skill acquisition theory to model the training data curation and agent training. We designed a two-stage correlation strategy for plan optimization, including self-correlation and model preference correlation. Additionally, we utilized the generated plans to train the MultiMedia-Agent via a three stage approach including base/success plan finetune and preference optimization. The comparison results demonstrate that the our approaches are effective and the MultiMedia-Agent can generate better multimedia content compared to novel models.

title: NavAI: A Generalizable LLM Framework for Navigation Tasks in Virtual Reality Environments
summary: Navigation is one of the fundamental tasks for automated exploration in Virtual Reality (VR). Existing technologies primarily focus on path optimization in 360-degree image datasets and 3D simulators, which cannot be directly applied to immersive VR environments. To address this gap, we present NavAI, a generalizable large language model (LLM)-based navigation framework that supports both basic actions and complex goal-directed tasks across diverse VR applications. We evaluate NavAI in three distinct VR environments through goal-oriented and exploratory tasks. Results show that it achieves high accuracy, with an 89% success rate in goal-oriented tasks. Our analysis also highlights current limitations of relying entirely on LLMs, particularly in scenarios that require dynamic goal assessment. Finally, we discuss the limitations observed during the experiments and offer insights for future research directions.

title: InfiniDepth: Arbitrary-Resolution and Fine-Grained Depth Estimation with Neural Implicit Fields
summary: Existing depth estimation methods are fundamentally limited to predicting depth on discrete image grids. Such representations restrict their scalability to arbitrary output resolutions and hinder the geometric detail recovery. This paper introduces InfiniDepth, which represents depth as neural implicit fields. Through a simple yet effective local implicit decoder, we can query depth at continuous 2D coordinates, enabling arbitrary-resolution and fine-grained depth estimation. To better assess our method's capabilities, we curate a high-quality 4K synthetic benchmark from five different games, spanning diverse scenes with rich geometric and appearance details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that InfiniDepth achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks across relative and metric depth estimation tasks, particularly excelling in fine-detail regions. It also benefits the task of novel view synthesis under large viewpoint shifts, producing high-quality results with fewer holes and artifacts.

title: Automated Semantic Rules Detection (ASRD) for Emergent Communication Interpretation
summary: The field of emergent communication within multi-agent systems examines how autonomous agents can independently develop communication strategies, without explicit programming, and adapt them to varied environments. However, few studies have focused on the interpretability of emergent languages. The research exposed in this paper proposes an Automated Semantic Rules Detection (ASRD) algorithm, which extracts relevant patterns in messages exchanged by agents trained with two different datasets on the Lewis Game, which is often studied in the context of emergent communication. ASRD helps at the interpretation of the emergent communication by relating the extracted patterns to specific attributes of the input data, thereby considerably simplifying subsequent analysis.

title: Muses: Designing, Composing, Generating Nonexistent Fantasy 3D Creatures without Training
summary: We present Muses, the first training-free method for fantastic 3D creature generation in a feed-forward paradigm. Previous methods, which rely on part-aware optimization, manual assembly, or 2D image generation, often produce unrealistic or incoherent 3D assets due to the challenges of intricate part-level manipulation and limited out-of-domain generation. In contrast, Muses leverages the 3D skeleton, a fundamental representation of biological forms, to explicitly and rationally compose diverse elements. This skeletal foundation formalizes 3D content creation as a structure-aware pipeline of design, composition, and generation. Muses begins by constructing a creatively composed 3D skeleton with coherent layout and scale through graph-constrained reasoning. This skeleton then guides a voxel-based assembly process within a structured latent space, integrating regions from different objects. Finally, image-guided appearance modeling under skeletal conditions is applied to generate a style-consistent and harmonious texture for the assembled shape. Extensive experiments establish Muses' state-of-the-art performance in terms of visual fidelity and alignment with textual descriptions, and potential on flexible 3D object editing. Project page: https://luhexiao.github.io/Muses.github.io/.

title: On (Newcomb-)Benford's law: a tale of two papers and of their disproportionate citations. How citation counts can become biased
summary: The first digit (FD) phenomenon i.e., the significant digits of numbers in large data are often distributed according to a logarithmically decreasing function was first reported by S. Newcomb and then many decades later independently by F. Benford. After its century long neglect the last three decades have seen huge growth in the number of relevant publications. However, notwithstanding the rising popularity the two independent proponents of the phenomenon are not equally acknowledged an indication of which is disproportionate number of citations accumulated by Newcomb (1881) and Benford (1938). In the present study use citation analysis to show that the formalization of the eponym Benford's law, a name questionable itself for overlooking Newcomb's contribution, by Raimi (1976) had a strong adverse effect on the future citations of Newcomb (1881). Furthermore, we identify the papers published over various decades of the developmental history of the FD phenomenon, which latter turned out to be amongst the most cited ones in the field. We find that lack of its consideration, intentional or occasionally out of ignorance for referencing by the prominent papers, is responsible for a far lesser number of citations of Newcomb (1881) in comparison to Benford (1938).

title: Detecting and Mitigating Treatment Leakage in Text-Based Causal Inference: Distillation and Sensitivity Analysis
summary: Text-based causal inference increasingly employs textual data as proxies for unobserved confounders, yet this approach introduces a previously undertheorized source of bias: treatment leakage. Treatment leakage occurs when text intended to capture confounding information also contains signals predictive of treatment status, thereby inducing post-treatment bias in causal estimates. Critically, this problem can arise even when documents precede treatment assignment, as authors may employ future-referencing language that anticipates subsequent interventions. Despite growing recognition of this issue, no systematic methods exist for identifying and mitigating treatment leakage in text-as-confounder applications. This paper addresses this gap through three contributions. First, we provide formal statistical and set-theoretic definitions of treatment leakage that clarify when and why bias occurs. Second, we propose four text distillation methods -- similarity-based passage removal, distant supervision classification, salient feature removal, and iterative nullspace projection -- designed to eliminate treatment-predictive content while preserving confounder information. Third, we validate these methods through simulations using synthetic text and an empirical application examining International Monetary Fund structural adjustment programs and child mortality. Our findings indicate that moderate distillation optimally balances bias reduction against confounder retention, whereas overly stringent approaches degrade estimate precision.

title: OpenFOAM computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solver for magnetohydrodynamic open cycles, applied to the Sakhalin pulsed magnetohydrodynamic generator (PMHDG)
comments: 45 pages, 22 figures, 6 tables, published journal article, peer-reviewed, open access
summary: In the current study, we present a mathematical and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model for simulating open-cycle linear Faraday-type continuous-electrode channels of magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) power generators, operating on combustion plasma. The model extends the Favre-averaged Navier-Stokes equations to account for the electric properties of the flowing plasma gas and its reaction to the applied magnetic field. The model takes into account various effects, such as the Lorentz force, turbulence, compressibility, and energy extraction from the plasma, and it adopts an electric potential technique along with the low magnetic Reynolds number (Rem) approximation. The model is numerically implemented using the multiphysics open-source computer programming environment "OpenFOAM," which combines the finite volume method (FVM) and the object-oriented programming (OOP) concept. The capabilities of the model are demonstrated by simulating the supersonic channel of the large-scale pulsed MHD generator (PMHDG) called "Sakhalin", with the aid of collected data and empirical expressions in the literature about its tested operation. Sakhalin was the world's largest PMHDG, with a demonstrated peak electric power output of 510 MW. Sakhalin operated on solid-propellant plasma (SPP), and it had a single supersonic divergent Faraday-type continuous-electrode channel with a length of 4.5 m. We check the validity of the model through comparisons with independent results for the Sakhalin PMHDG. Then, we process our three-dimensional simulation results to provide scalar characteristics of the Sakhalin channel, one-dimensional profiles along the longitudinal centerline, and three-dimensional distributions in the entire channel.
comment: 45 pages, 22 figures, 6 tables, published journal article, peer-reviewed, open access

title: Expert-Guided Explainable Few-Shot Learning with Active Sample Selection for Medical Image Analysis
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics, 2025
summary: Medical image analysis faces two critical challenges: scarcity of labeled data and lack of model interpretability, both hindering clinical AI deployment. Few-shot learning (FSL) addresses data limitations but lacks transparency in predictions. Active learning (AL) methods optimize data acquisition but overlook interpretability of acquired samples. We propose a dual-framework solution: Expert-Guided Explainable Few-Shot Learning (EGxFSL) and Explainability-Guided AL (xGAL). EGxFSL integrates radiologist-defined regions-of-interest as spatial supervision via Grad-CAM-based Dice loss, jointly optimized with prototypical classification for interpretable few-shot learning. xGAL introduces iterative sample acquisition prioritizing both predictive uncertainty and attention misalignment, creating a closed-loop framework where explainability guides training and sample selection synergistically. On the BraTS (MRI), VinDr-CXR (chest X-ray), and SIIM-COVID-19 (chest X-ray) datasets, we achieve accuracies of 92\%, 76\%, and 62\%, respectively, consistently outperforming non-guided baselines across all datasets. Under severe data constraints, xGAL achieves 76\% accuracy with only 680 samples versus 57\% for random sampling. Grad-CAM visualizations demonstrate guided models focus on diagnostically relevant regions, with generalization validated on breast ultrasound confirming cross-modality applicability.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics, 2025

title: A large-scale nanocrystal database with aligned synthesis and properties enabling generative inverse design
summary: The synthesis of nanocrystals has been highly dependent on trial-and-error, due to the complex correlation between synthesis parameters and physicochemical properties. Although deep learning offers a potential methodology to achieve generative inverse design, it is still hindered by the scarcity of high-quality datasets that align nanocrystal synthesis routes with their properties. Here, we present the construction of a large-scale, aligned Nanocrystal Synthesis-Property (NSP) database and demonstrate its capability for generative inverse design. To extract structured synthesis routes and their corresponding product properties from literature, we develop NanoExtractor, a large language model (LLM) enhanced by well-designed augmentation strategies. NanoExtractor is validated against human experts, achieving a weighted average score of 88% on the test set, significantly outperforming chemistry-specialized (3%) and general-purpose LLMs (38%). The resulting NSP database contains nearly 160,000 aligned entries and serves as training data for our NanoDesigner, an LLM for inverse synthesis design. The generative capability of NanoDesigner is validated through the successful design of viable synthesis routes for both well-established PbSe nanocrystals and rarely reported MgF2 nanocrystals. Notably, the model recommends a counter-intuitive, non-stoichiometric precursor ratio (1:1) for MgF2 nanocrystals, which is experimentally confirmed as critical for suppressing byproducts. Our work bridges the gap between unstructured literature and data-driven synthesis, and also establishes a powerful human-AI collaborative paradigm for accelerating nanocrystal discovery.

title: Formal Modeling and Verification of Grover's Algorithm
summary: Grover's algorithm relies on the superposition and interference of quantum mechanics, which is more efficient than classical computing in specific tasks such as searching an unsorted database. Due to the high complexity of quantum mechanics, the correctness of quantum algorithms is difficult to guarantee through traditional simulation methods. By contrast, the fundamental concepts and mathematical structure of Grover's algorithm can be formalized into logical expressions and verified by higher-order logical reasoning. In this paper, we formally model and verify Grover's algorithm in the HOL Light theorem prover. We focus on proving key properties such as the unitarity of its oracle and diffusion operators, the monotonicity of the success probability with respect to the number of iterations, and an exact expression for the optimal iteration count. By analyzing a concrete application to integer factorization, we demonstrate the practicality and prospects of our work.
