Extensive experiments are conducted with five major jailbreak attack methods across three mainstream MLLMs. Results demonstrate that our E$^2$AT achieves the state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing baselines by an average margin of 34\% across text and image modalities, while maintaining clean task performance. Furthermore, evaluations of real-world embodied intelligent systems highlight the practical applicability of E$^2$AT, paving the way for the development of more secure and reliable multimodal systems. Our code is available on \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/E2AT_568}{\textcolor{red}{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/E2AT\_568}}.

title: From Intrinsic Toxicity to Reception-Based Toxicity: A Contextual Framework for Prediction and Evaluation
summary: Most toxicity detection models treat toxicity as an intrinsic property of text, overlooking the role of context in shaping its impact. In this position paper, drawing on insights from psychology, neuroscience, and computational social science, we reconceptualise toxicity as a socially emergent signal of stress. We formalise this perspective in the Contextual Stress Framework (CSF), which defines toxicity as a stress-inducing norm violation within a given context and introduces an additional dimension for toxicity detection. As one possible realisation of CSF, we introduce PONOS (Proportion Of Negative Observed Sentiments), a metric that quantifies toxicity through collective social reception rather than lexical features. We validate this approach on a novel dataset, demonstrating improved contextual sensitivity and adaptability when used alongside existing models.

AI.title_translation: 从内在毒性到基于接收的毒性：一个用于预测和评估的情境化框架
AI.tldr: 传统毒性检测忽略了情境。本文提出CSF框架，将毒性视为情境内的社会压力信号，并引入PONOS指标，该指标基于社会接收而非词汇来衡量毒性，并在实验中显示出更好的上下文适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有毒性检测模型将毒性视为文本的固有属性，忽略了情境在塑造毒性影响中的作用。
AI.method: 提出情境压力框架（Contextual Stress Framework, CSF），将毒性重新概念化为情境内的压力诱发规范违反；引入PONOS（观察到的负面情绪比例）作为量化毒性的指标，该指标通过集体社会接收而非词汇特征来衡量。
AI.result: 在新的数据集上验证了PONOS方法，证明了其在上下文敏感性和适应性方面优于现有模型，并且可以与现有模型结合使用。
AI.conclusion: CSF提供了一个将毒性视为情境内压力诱发规范违反的理论框架，而PONOS作为其实例，通过集体社会接收而非词汇特征来量化毒性，并在新数据集上验证了其优于现有模型的上下文敏感性和适应性。
AI.translation: 大多数毒性检测模型将毒性视为文本的固有属性，却忽略了情境在塑造其影响中的作用。在本篇立场性论文中，我们借鉴心理学、神经科学和计算社会科学的见解，将毒性重新概念化为一种社会涌现的压力信号。我们将这一观点形式化为情境压力框架（CSF），它将毒性定义为给定情境内诱发压力的规范违反，并为毒性检测引入了一个额外的维度。作为CSF的一种可能实现，我们引入了PONOS（观察到的负面情绪比例），一个通过集体社会接收而非词汇特征来量化毒性的指标。我们用一个新颖的数据集验证了这种方法，证明了它与现有模型一起使用时具有更高的上下文敏感性和适应性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的毒性检测范式，将毒性从文本的固有属性重新概念化为一种情境化的、由社会接收产生的压力信号。为此，作者提出了情境压力框架（CSF），并引入了一个基于集体社会接收而非传统词汇特征的度量指标PONOS，实验证明了该方法在上下文敏感性方面的改进。
AI.keywords: 文本毒性, 情境化框架, 社会信号, 压力诱发, PONOS
AI.comments: 该论文的关键创新在于将文本毒性从固有的文本属性重新概念化为一种“情境化压力信号”，提出了一个理论框架（CSF），并提供了一个基于社会接收而非词汇特征的量化指标（PONOS）。其主要局限性可能在于对“社会压力”和“规范违反”的界定和量化难度。该研究对毒性检测领域具有重要意义，因为它强调了社会情境在判断文本毒性中的核心作用。

title: Offline Model-Based Optimization: Comprehensive Review
summary: Offline optimization is a fundamental challenge in science and engineering, where the goal is to optimize black-box functions using only offline datasets. This setting is particularly relevant when querying the objective function is prohibitively expensive or infeasible, with applications spanning protein engineering, material discovery, neural architecture search, and beyond. The main difficulty lies in accurately estimating the objective landscape beyond the available data, where extrapolations are fraught with significant epistemic uncertainty. This uncertainty can lead to objective hacking(reward hacking), exploiting model inaccuracies in unseen regions, or other spurious optimizations that yield misleadingly high performance estimates outside the training distribution. Recent advances in model-based optimization(MBO) have harnessed the generalization capabilities of deep neural networks to develop offline-specific surrogate and generative models. Trained with carefully designed strategies, these models are more robust against out-of-distribution issues, facilitating the discovery of improved designs. Despite its growing impact in accelerating scientific discovery, the field lacks a comprehensive review. To bridge this gap, we present the first thorough review of offline MBO. We begin by formalizing the problem for both single-objective and multi-objective settings and by reviewing recent benchmarks and evaluation metrics. We then categorize existing approaches into two key areas: surrogate modeling, which emphasizes accurate function approximation in out-of-distribution regions, and generative modeling, which explores high-dimensional design spaces to identify high-performing designs. Finally, we examine the key challenges and propose promising directions for advancement in this rapidly evolving field including safe control of superintelligent systems.

AI.title_translation: 离线模型优化：综合回顾
AI.tldr: 离线优化使用现有数据集优化黑盒函数，模型不确定性是主要挑战。深度学习驱动的模型优化（MBO）通过稳健的模型（代理和生成模型）解决了这一问题，加速了科学发现。本综述首次全面回顾了离线MBO，涵盖了问题形式化、基准、评估指标、现有方法（代理建模和生成建模）以及未来的挑战和方向。
AI.motivation: 科学和工程领域面临离线优化挑战，即仅使用离线数据集优化黑盒函数。当查询目标函数成本高昂或不可行时，此设置尤为重要，应用范围涵盖蛋白质工程、材料发现、神经架构搜索等。主要难点在于准确估计可用数据之外的目标函数分布，而外推则充满显著的认知不确定性。
AI.method: 本综述首次全面回顾了离线模型优化（MBO）。我们首先为单目标和多目标设置形式化问题，并回顾了最近的基准和评估指标。然后，我们将现有方法分为两大类：代理建模，强调在分布外区域进行准确的函数逼近；以及生成建模，探索高维设计空间以识别高性能设计。
AI.result: 本综述首次全面回顾了离线模型优化（MBO），涵盖了问题形式化、基准、评估指标、现有方法（代理建模和生成建模）以及未来的挑战和方向。
AI.conclusion: 本综述首次全面回顾了离线模型优化（MBO），涵盖了问题形式化、基准、评估指标、现有方法（代理建模和生成建模）以及未来的挑战和方向。
AI.translation: 离线优化是科学和工程中的一个基本挑战，其目标是仅使用离线数据集来优化黑盒函数。当查询目标函数成本高昂或不可行时，这种情况尤其重要，其应用涵盖蛋白质工程、材料发现、神经架构搜索等领域。主要难点在于准确估计可用数据之外的目标函数分布，而外推则充满显著的认知不确定性。这种不确定性可能导致目标函数攻击（奖励攻击），利用模型在未见区域的准确性，或产生其他虚假的优化，在训练分布之外产生误导性的高性能估计。模型优化（MBO）的最新进展利用了深度神经网络的泛化能力，开发了针对离线的代理和生成模型。这些模型通过精心设计的策略进行训练，对分布外问题更加稳健，有助于发现改进的设计。尽管其在加速科学发现方面的影响日益增长，但该领域仍缺乏全面的回顾。为了弥补这一差距，我们对离线MBO进行了首次彻底的回顾。我们首先为单目标和多目标设置形式化问题，并回顾了最近的基准和评估指标。然后，我们将现有方法分为两大类：代理建模，强调在分布外区域进行准确的函数逼近；以及生成建模，探索高维设计空间以识别高性能设计。最后，我们考察了关键挑战，并为这个快速发展的领域提出了有希望的进展方向，包括对超智能系统的安全控制。
AI.summary: 本综述全面回顾了离线模型优化（MBO）领域，该领域旨在利用现有数据集优化黑盒函数。文章解决了在数据稀疏或查询成本高昂的情况下进行准确函数逼近和有效探索的挑战，重点介绍了基于深度学习的代理和生成模型。该研究对离线MBO问题进行了形式化，回顾了相关基准和评估指标，并将现有方法分为代理建模和生成建模两大类，最后探讨了该领域的未来挑战和发展方向。
AI.keywords: 离线优化,模型优化,代理建模,生成建模,不确定性量化
AI.comments: 该综述首次全面回顾了离线模型优化（MBO）领域，解决了在数据稀疏或查询成本高昂的情况下进行准确函数逼近和有效探索的挑战，重点介绍了基于深度学习的代理和生成模型。该研究对离线MBO问题进行了形式化，回顾了相关基准和评估指标，并将现有方法分为代理建模和生成建模两大类，最后探讨了该领域的未来挑战和发展方向。文章的创新性在于其全面性，为该领域的研究者提供了一个清晰的路线图。文章的局限性在于，它主要关注理论和方法，而对实际应用的讨论相对较少。

title: Graph-Structured Driven Dual Adaptation for Mitigating Popularity Bias
summary:
Popularity bias is a common challenge in recommender systems. It often causes unbalanced item recommendation performance and intensifies the Matthew effect. Due to limited user-item interactions, unpopular items are frequently constrained to the embedding neighborhoods of only a few users, leading to representation collapse and weakening the model's generalization. Although existing supervised alignment and reweighting methods can help mitigate this problem, they still face two major limitations: (1) they overlook the inherent variability among different Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) layers, which can result in negative gains in deeper layers; (2) they rely heavily on fixed hyperparameters to balance popular and unpopular items, limiting adaptability to diverse data distributions and increasing model complexity.
  To address these challenges, we propose Graph-Structured Dual Adaptation Framework (GSDA), a dual adaptive framework for mitigating popularity bias in recommendation. Our theoretical analysis shows that supervised alignment in GCNs is hindered by the over-smoothing effect, where the distinction between popular and unpopular items diminishes as layers deepen, reducing the effectiveness of alignment at deeper levels. To overcome this limitation, GSDA integrates a hierarchical adaptive alignment mechanism that counteracts entropy decay across layers together with a distribution-aware contrastive weighting strategy based on the Gini coefficient, enabling the model to adapt its debiasing strength dynamically without relying on fixed hyperparameters. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that GSDA effectively alleviates popularity bias while consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods in recommendation performance.

AI.title_translation: 基于图结构驱动的双重自适应方法以减轻流行度偏差
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为GSDA的双重自适应框架，通过分层自适应对齐和基于吉尼系数的分布感知对比加权策略来解决推荐系统中的流行度偏差问题，克服了现有方法在GCN层间变异性和超参数依赖性方面的局限性，并在实验中证明了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统中普遍存在的流行度偏差会导致推荐性能不平衡和马太效应加剧。现有方法忽略了GCN层间的内在变异性，并在深度层中可能产生负面影响，同时依赖固定的超参数来平衡流行和不流行物品，限制了对不同数据分布的适应性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为GSDA的双重自适应框架，该框架包含分层自适应对齐机制以对抗跨层的熵衰减，以及基于吉尼系数的分布感知对比加权策略，从而动态调整去偏强度，无需固定超参数。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，GSDA能有效缓解流行度偏差，并且在推荐性能上持续优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: GSDA框架通过分层自适应对齐和分布感知对比加权策略，成功地解决了推荐系统中流行度偏差的问题，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在实验中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation:
流行度偏差是推荐系统中普遍存在的挑战。它经常导致不平衡的项目推荐性能，并加剧马太效应。由于用户-项目交互有限，不受欢迎的项目经常被限制在少数用户的嵌入邻域内，导致表示坍塌并削弱模型的泛化能力。尽管现有的监督对齐和重新加权方法有助于缓解这个问题，但它们仍然面临两个主要限制：(1) 它们忽略了不同图卷积网络（GCN）层之间固有的变异性，这可能导致更深层的负面收益；(2) 它们严重依赖固定的超参数来平衡流行和不流行的项目，限制了对不同数据分布的适应性，并增加了模型的复杂性。
为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了图结构双重自适应框架（GSDA），这是一个用于减轻推荐中流行度偏差的双重自适应框架。我们的理论分析表明，GCN中的监督对齐受到过平滑效应的阻碍，随着层数的加深，流行项目和不流行项目之间的区别逐渐减小，降低了在更深层对齐的有效性。为了克服这一限制，GSDA整合了一个分层自适应对齐机制，以对抗跨层的熵衰减，以及一个基于吉尼系数的分布感知对比加权策略，使模型能够动态地调整其去偏强度，而无需依赖固定的超参数。在三个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，GSDA有效地缓解了流行度偏差，并在推荐性能上持续优于最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为GSDA（Graph-Structured Dual Adaptation）的双重自适应框架，旨在解决推荐系统中的流行度偏差问题。GSDA通过引入分层自适应对齐机制来应对GCN层间的过平滑效应，并结合基于吉尼系数的分布感知对比加权策略，实现了动态的去偏强度调整，无需依赖固定超参数。实验结果表明，GSDA在多个数据集上有效缓解了流行度偏差，并取得了优于现有方法的推荐性能。
AI.keywords: 流行度偏差,图卷积网络,双重自适应,分层对齐,对比加权
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的双重自适应框架GSDA，通过分层自适应对齐和分布感知对比加权策略来解决推荐系统中的流行度偏差问题。该方法有效地解决了现有技术中的两个关键限制：GCN层间的变异性和对固定超参数的依赖性。理论分析和实验结果均表明了该方法的有效性，尤其是在应对过平滑效应和动态调整去偏强度方面。该研究对于提高推荐系统的公平性和鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: Self-Routing RAG: Binding Selective Retrieval with Knowledge Verbalization
summary: Selective retrieval aims to make retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) more efficient and reliable by skipping retrieval when an LLM's parametric knowledge suffices. Despite promising results, existing methods are constrained by a binary design choice: either retrieve from a single external source or skip retrieval and let the LLM directly produce the final answer. We argue that this fallback underestimates the model's knowledge and obscures the more general multi-source decision problem that arises in practical systems. We propose Self-Routing RAG (SR-RAG), which casts selective retrieval as knowledge source selection and treats the LLM itself as a first-class knowledge source. SR-RAG learns to select an appropriate knowledge source, optionally verbalize parametric knowledge, and answer using the selected source, all within a single left-to-right generation pass. SR-RAG further augments source selection by combining LLM-based uncertainty with a flexible external policy datastore to improve decision calibration. Across four benchmarks and three 7B-class LLMs, SR-RAG outperforms a strong selective retrieval baseline by 8.5%/2.1%/4.7% while performing 26%/40%/21% fewer retrievals, and it achieves favorable accuracy-latency trade-offs without dataset-specific threshold tuning.

AI.title_translation: 自路由检索增强生成：绑定选择性检索与知识释义
AI.tldr: SR-RAG 通过将 LLM 本身视为一个知识源，并学习在检索外部知识或直接生成答案之间进行选择，从而提高了 RAG 的效率和可靠性。它在多个基准测试中优于现有方法，同时减少了检索次数。
AI.motivation: 现有的选择性检索方法受限于二元选择：要么从单一外部源检索，要么完全跳过检索。这种方法低估了模型的知识，未能解决实际系统中更普遍的多源选择问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 SR-RAG 的新方法，该方法将知识源选择视为一个问题，并将 LLM 本身视为一个一等知识源。SR-RAG 学习在单个左到右生成过程中选择适当的知识源、可选地释义其参数化知识，并使用所选源进行回答。此外，SR-RAG 还通过结合基于 LLM 的不确定性和灵活的外部策略数据存储来增强源选择，以改进决策校准。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试和三个 7B 级 LLM 上，SR-RAG 的表现优于强大的选择性检索基线 8.5%/2.1%/4.7%，同时检索次数减少了 26%/40%/21%。它在没有数据集特定阈值调整的情况下实现了有利的准确性-延迟权衡。
AI.conclusion: SR-RAG 是一种新的选择性检索方法，它将 LLM 本身视为一个知识源，并学习在检索外部知识和利用 LLM 的内部知识之间进行动态选择，从而提高了 RAG 的效率和性能。
AI.translation: 选择性检索旨在通过在 LLM 的参数化知识足够时跳过检索来提高检索增强生成的效率和可靠性。尽管取得了有希望的结果，但现有方法受到二元设计选择的限制：要么从单一外部源检索，要么跳过检索并让 LLM 直接生成最终答案。我们认为，这种回退低估了模型的知识，并掩盖了实际系统中出现的更普遍的多源选择问题。我们提出了自路由 RAG (SR-RAG)，它将选择性检索视为知识源选择，并将 LLM 本身视为一等知识源。SR-RAG 在单个左到右生成过程中学习选择适当的知识源、可选地释义参数化知识，并使用所选源进行回答。SR-RAG 进一步通过结合基于 LLM 的不确定性与灵活的外部策略数据存储来增强源选择，以改进决策校准。在四个基准测试和三个 7B 级 LLM 上，SR-RAG 的表现优于强大的选择性检索基线 8.5%/2.1%/4.7%，同时检索次数减少了 26%/40%/21%，并且在没有数据集特定阈值调整的情况下实现了有利的准确性-延迟权衡。
AI.summary: SR-RAG 是一种新颖的选择性检索方法，它将 LLM 视为一个知识源，并学习在检索外部知识和利用 LLM 的内部知识之间进行动态选择。该方法通过在单个生成过程中路由到最合适的知识源来提高 RAG 的效率和性能，并在多个基准测试中取得了优于现有方法的成果。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成,选择性检索,知识源选择,自路由,LLM
AI.comments: 这项工作通过将 LLM 自身视为一个独立的知识源，并提出了一种自路由机制来动态选择知识来源，从而在选择性检索领域取得了显著进展。SR-RAG 的主要创新在于其将选择性检索问题重新构建为知识源选择问题，并实现了在单个生成过程中整合外部检索和内部知识利用的能力。这种方法不仅提高了效率（通过减少检索次数），而且在多个基准测试中也提高了准确性。此外，通过结合 LLM 的不确定性和外部策略数据存储来改进决策校准，这为未来的研究提供了有价值的见解。然而，该方法在处理复杂或多模态知识源方面的可扩展性以及对不同 LLM 架构的适应性仍有待进一步探索。

title: EgoLog: Ego-Centric Fine-Grained Daily Log with Ubiquitous Wearables
summary: Despite advances in human activity recognition (HAR) with different modalities, a precise, robust, and accurate daily log system is not yet available. Current solutions primarily rely on controlled, lab-based data collection, which limits their real-world applicability. The challenges towards a fine-grained daily log are 1) contextual awareness, 2) spatial awareness, and 3) effective fusion of multi-modal sensor data. To solve them, we propose EgoLog, which integrates effective audio-IMU fusion for daily log with ubiquitous wearables. Our approach first fuses audio and IMU data from two perspectives: temporal understanding and spatial understanding. We extract scenario-level features and aggregate them in the time dimension, while using motion compensation to enhance the performance of sound source localization. The knowledge obtained from these steps is then integrated into a multi-modal HAR framework. Here, the scenario provides prior knowledge, and the spatial location helps differentiate the user from the background. Furthermore, we integrate a LLM to enhance scenario recognition through logical reasoning. The knowledge derived from the LLM is subsequently transferred back to the local device to enable efficient, on-device inference. Evaluated on both public and self-collected dataset, EgoLog achieves effective multimodal fusion for both activity and scenraio recognition, outperforms the baseline by 12% and 15%, respectively.

AI.title_translation: EgoLog：基于普遍可穿戴设备的自我中心精细化日常日志
AI.tldr: EgoLog利用可穿戴设备上的音频和IMU数据，结合LLM的推理能力，创建了一个更精确、更实用的日常活动和场景日志系统，性能显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的活动识别（HAR）解决方案主要依赖于受控的实验室数据收集，限制了其在现实世界中的应用。因此，需要一个精确、稳健且准确的日常日志系统来解决上下文感知、空间感知和多模态传感器数据有效融合的挑战。
AI.method: EgoLog首先从时间理解和空间理解两个角度融合音频和IMU数据，提取情景级特征并按时间维度聚合，同时使用运动补偿来增强声源定位性能。然后，将这些知识集成到多模态HAR框架中，其中情景提供先验知识，空间位置帮助区分用户和背景。此外，集成LLM通过逻辑推理增强情景识别，并将LLM获得的知识迁移回本地设备以实现高效的设备端推理。
AI.result: EgoLog在活动识别和场景识别方面均实现了有效的多模态融合，性能分别超越基线方法12%和15%。
AI.conclusion: EgoLog通过有效的多模态融合和LLM增强的推理能力，实现了对活动和场景的有效识别，并在公共和自采数据集上显著优于基线方法。
AI.translation: 尽管在不同模态的人类活动识别（HAR）方面取得了进展，但精确、稳健和准确的日常日志系统尚未出现。目前的解决方案主要依赖于受控的、基于实验室的数据收集，这限制了它们在现实世界中的适用性。实现精细化日常日志的挑战在于1）上下文感知，2）空间感知，以及3）多模态传感器数据的有效融合。为解决这些问题，我们提出了EgoLog，它集成了有效的音频-IMU融合技术，用于日常日志记录，并利用普遍存在的可穿戴设备。我们的方法首先从时间理解和空间理解两个角度融合音频和IMU数据。我们提取情景级特征并在时间维度上聚合它们，同时使用运动补偿来增强声源定位的性能。从这些步骤中获得的知识随后被集成到一个多模态HAR框架中。在这里，情景提供先验知识，空间位置有助于区分用户和背景。此外，我们集成了一个LLM，通过逻辑推理来增强情景识别。随后，从LLM获得的知识被迁移回本地设备，以实现高效的设备端推理。在公共和自采数据集上进行评估，EgoLog在活动和情景识别方面均实现了有效的多模态融合，性能分别超越基线方法12%和15%。
AI.summary: EgoLog提出了一种利用普遍存在的可穿戴设备，通过有效的音频-IMU数据融合和引入LLM进行逻辑推理来增强场景识别的方法，以实现精细化的自我中心日常日志记录。该方法解决了上下文、空间感知和多模态数据融合的挑战，并在评估中显示出优于基线方法的性能。
AI.keywords: EgoLog, 日志记录, 可穿戴设备, 音频-IMU融合, 场景识别
AI.comments: EgoLog的创新之处在于它有效地融合了音频和惯性测量单元（IMU）数据，并引入了大型语言模型（LLM）进行逻辑推理以增强场景识别，这对于从日常可穿戴设备中获取精细化日志具有重要意义。其局限性在于对LLM知识的设备端迁移效率尚未在摘要中具体量化。

title: Solving the Paint Shop Problem with Flexible Management of Multi-Lane Buffers Using Reinforcement Learning and Action Masking
summary: In the paint shop problem, an unordered incoming sequence of cars assigned to different colors has to be reshuffled with the objective of minimizing the number of color changes. To reshuffle the incoming sequence, manufacturers can employ a first-in-first-out multi-lane buffer system allowing store and retrieve operations. So far, prior studies primarily focused on simple decision heuristics like greedy or simplified problem variants that do not allow full flexibility when performing store and retrieve operations. In this study, we propose a reinforcement learning approach to minimize color changes for the flexible problem variant, where store and retrieve operations can be performed in an arbitrary order. After proving that greedy retrieval is optimal, we incorporate this finding into the model using action masking. Our evaluation, based on 170 problem instances with 2-8 buffer lanes and 5-15 colors, shows that our approach reduces color changes compared to existing methods by considerable margins depending on the problem size. Furthermore, we demonstrate the robustness of our approach towards different buffer sizes and imbalanced color distributions.

AI.title_translation: 使用强化学习和动作掩码解决具有多车道缓冲区灵活管理的油漆车间问题
AI.tldr: 使用强化学习和动作掩码解决油漆车间问题，通过允许任意顺序的存取操作，显著减少了颜色切换次数，并且对不同缓冲区大小和颜色分布表现稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要集中在简单的决策启发式或简化的问题变体上，这些变体不允许在执行存储和检索操作时具有完全的灵活性，而本研究旨在解决具有这种灵活性的问题变体，以最小化颜色变化。
AI.method: 提出了一种强化学习方法，并通过将贪婪检索最优的发现纳入模型中，利用动作掩码来处理完全灵活的存取操作。
AI.result: 在170个问题实例（2-8个缓冲区车道和5-15种颜色）上的评估显示，与现有方法相比，颜色变化有了显著的减少，并且证明了该方法对不同缓冲区大小和不平衡颜色分布的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法显著减少了颜色变化，并且对不同的缓冲区大小和不平衡的颜色分布具有鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 在油漆车间问题中，必须重新排列分配给不同颜色的无序进场汽车序列，目标是最小化颜色变化次数。为了重新排列进场序列，制造商可以采用允许多存储和检索操作的先进先出多车道缓冲区系统。迄今为止，先前的研究主要集中在简单的决策启发式方法，如贪婪算法或简化的问题变体，这些变体不允许在执行存储和检索操作时具有完全的灵活性。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种强化学习方法，以最小化灵活问题变体的颜色变化，在这种变体中，存储和检索操作可以按任意顺序执行。在证明贪婪检索是最优的之后，我们使用动作掩码将这一发现纳入模型中。我们基于170个问题实例（2-8个缓冲区车道和5-15种颜色）的评估表明，与现有方法相比，我们的方法在颜色变化方面有了显著的减少，具体减少幅度取决于问题规模。此外，我们证明了我们的方法对不同缓冲区大小和不平衡颜色分布的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用强化学习和动作掩码来解决油漆车间问题中具有灵活存取操作的变体，目标是最小化颜色切换次数。通过将贪婪检索最优的发现整合到模型中，该方法在多个实例上优于现有方法，并显示出对不同配置的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 油漆车间问题, 强化学习, 动作掩码, 多车道缓冲区, 颜色切换最小化
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将强化学习与动作掩码技术结合，解决了传统方法难以处理的具有完全灵活存取操作的油漆车间问题变体。其重要性在于显著减少了颜色切换次数，并证明了方法在不同缓冲区大小和颜色分布下的鲁棒性。局限性可能在于对“任意顺序”存取操作的灵活性的精确建模和求解难度。

title: Heuristic Methods are Good Teachers to Distill MLPs for Graph Link Prediction
summary: Link prediction is a crucial graph-learning task with applications including citation prediction and product recommendation. Distilling Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) teachers into Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) students has emerged as an effective approach to achieve strong performance and reducing computational cost by removing graph dependency. However, existing distillation methods only use standard GNNs and overlook alternative teachers such as specialized model for link prediction (GNN4LP) and heuristic methods (e.g., common neighbors). This paper first explores the impact of different teachers in GNN-to-MLP distillation. Surprisingly, we find that stronger teachers do not always produce stronger students: MLPs distilled from GNN4LP can underperform those distilled from simpler GNNs, while weaker heuristic methods can teach MLPs to near-GNN performance with drastically reduced training costs. Building on these insights, we propose Ensemble Heuristic-Distilled MLPs (EHDM), which eliminates graph dependencies while effectively integrating complementary signals via a gating mechanism. Experiments on ten datasets show an average 7.93% improvement over previous GNN-to-MLP approaches with 1.95-3.32 times less training time, indicating EHDM is an efficient and effective link prediction method.

AI.title_translation: 启发式方法是蒸馏 MLP 进行图链接预测的优秀教师
AI.tldr: 研究发现，启发式方法可以比 GNNs 更有效地教会 MLP 进行图链接预测，并提出了一种名为 EHDM 的新方法，该方法在提高性能的同时减少了训练时间。
AI.motivation: 现有的 GNN-到-MLP 蒸馏方法忽略了启发式方法等替代教师，而这些方法可能在图链接预测任务中更有效。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 EHDM 的方法，该方法集成了启发式教师的信号，并通过门控机制消除了图依赖性。
AI.result: 与现有的 GNN-到-MLP 方法相比，EHDM 在十个数据集上平均提高了 7.93%，同时训练时间减少了 1.95-3.32 倍。
AI.conclusion: 启发式方法可以作为比 GNNs 更好的教师来蒸馏 MLP 进行图链接预测，并且提出的 EHDM 方法是一种高效且有效的链接预测方法。
AI.translation: 链接预测是一项关键的图学习任务，其应用包括引文预测和产品推荐。将图神经网络（GNN）教师蒸馏到多层感知机（MLP）学生已成为一种有效的方法，通过消除图依赖性来获得强劲的性能并降低计算成本。然而，现有的蒸馏方法仅使用标准的 GNN，并忽略了专门用于链接预测的模型（GNN4LP）和启发式方法（例如，共同邻居）等替代教师。本文首先探讨了不同教师在 GNN-to-MLP 蒸馏中的影响。令人惊讶的是，我们发现更强的教师并不总是产生更强的学生：从 GNN4LP 蒸馏出的 MLP 的性能可能不如从更简单的 GNN 蒸馏出的 MLP，而较弱的启发式方法可以教会 MLP 达到接近 GNN 的性能，同时大大降低训练成本。基于这些见解，我们提出了集成启发式蒸馏 MLP（EHDM），它消除了图依赖性，同时通过门控机制有效地整合了互补信号。在十个数据集上的实验表明，与以前的 GNN-to-MLP 方法相比，平均提高了 7.93%，同时训练时间减少了 1.95-3.32 倍，表明 EHDM 是一种高效且有效的链接预测方法。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在图链接预测任务中，使用启发式方法而非 GNNs 来蒸馏 MLP 的有效性。研究发现，启发式方法在提供更快的训练速度和接近 GNN 性能的学生模型方面表现出色。基于此，研究者提出了一种名为 EHDM 的集成启发式蒸馏 MLP 方法，该方法通过门控机制消除了图依赖性，并在实验中取得了优于现有方法的性能和效率。
AI.keywords: 图链接预测, 蒸馏, MLP, 启发式方法, GNN
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于挑战了“更强的教师总是产生更强的学生”这一普遍假设，并证明了启发式方法在 GNN 蒸馏中的潜力。其提出的 EHDM 方法在性能和效率上都取得了显著的改进，为图链接预测领域提供了新的解决方案。然而，文章可能需要进一步探讨不同启发式方法的组合策略以及 EHDM 在更大规模图上的泛化能力。

title: Efficient Swept Volume-Based Trajectory Generation for Arbitrary-Shaped Ground Robot Navigation
summary: Navigating an arbitrary-shaped ground robot safely in cluttered environments remains a challenging problem. The existing trajectory planners that account for the robot's physical geometry severely suffer from the intractable runtime. To achieve both computational efficiency and Continuous Collision Avoidance (CCA) of arbitrary-shaped ground robot planning, we proposed a novel coarse-to-fine navigation framework that significantly accelerates planning. In the first stage, a sampling-based method selectively generates distinct topological paths that guarantee a minimum inflated margin. In the second stage, a geometry-aware front-end strategy is designed to discretize these topologies into full-state robot motion sequences while concurrently partitioning the paths into SE(2) sub-problems and simpler R2 sub-problems for back-end optimization. In the final stage, an SVSDF-based optimizer generates trajectories tailored to these sub-problems and seamlessly splices them into a continuous final motion plan. Extensive benchmark comparisons show that the proposed method is one to several orders of magnitude faster than the cutting-edge methods in runtime while maintaining a high planning success rate and ensuring CCA.

AI.title_translation: 面向任意形状地面机器人导航的基于扫掠体积的高效轨迹生成
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的粗到精框架来高效地为任意形状地面机器人生成满足连续碰撞避免的轨迹，通过将规划分解为子问题并使用SVSDF优化，实现了比现有方法快几个数量级的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 在拥挤环境中安全导航任意形状的地面机器人是一个具有挑战性的问题，现有考虑机器人物理几何形状的轨迹规划器存在运行时难以处理（intractable runtime）的问题。目标是实现计算效率和任意形状地面机器人规划的连续碰撞避免（CCA）。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的粗到精导航框架。第一阶段使用基于采样的（sampling-based）方法生成保证最小充气裕度的拓扑路径。第二阶段，一个几何感知的（geometry-aware）前端策略将这些拓扑结构离散化为完整的机器人运动序列，并同时将路径划分为SE(2)子问题和更简单的R2子问题，以供后端优化。最后阶段，一个基于SVSDF的优化器为这些子问题生成定制轨迹，并将它们无缝拼接成连续的最终运动规划。
AI.result: 与最先进的方法相比，所提出的方法在运行时快一到几个数量级，同时保持了高规划成功率并确保了CCA。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在运行时比最先进的方法快一到几个数量级，同时保持了高规划成功率并确保了连续碰撞避免（CCA）。
AI.translation: 在拥挤环境中安全导航任意形状的地面机器人仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。现有考虑机器人物理几何形状的轨迹规划器严重受到运行时难以处理的困扰。为了实现任意形状地面机器人规划的计算效率和连续碰撞避免（CCA），我们提出了一种新颖的粗到精导航框架，显著加速了规划过程。在第一阶段，一种基于采样的方法选择性地生成保证最小充气裕度的不同拓扑路径。在第二阶段，设计了一种几何感知的（geometry-aware）前端策略，将这些拓扑结构离散化为完整的机器人运动序列，同时将路径划分为SE(2)子问题和更简单的R2子问题，以供后端优化。在最后阶段，一个基于SVSDF的优化器为这些子问题生成定制轨迹，并将它们无缝地拼接成连续的最终运动规划。广泛的基准比较表明，与最先进的方法相比，所提出的方法在运行时快一到几个数量级，同时保持了高规划成功率并确保了CCA。
AI.summary: 为解决任意形状地面机器人在复杂环境中安全导航的效率和连续碰撞避免问题，本文提出了一种粗到精的导航框架。该框架首先生成拓扑路径，然后将路径分解为SE(2)和R2子问题，最后使用SVSDF优化器生成并拼接轨迹。实验证明，该方法在速度上显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 任意形状地面机器人, 轨迹生成, 连续碰撞避免, 粗到精框架, SVSDF
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个新颖的粗到精导航框架，通过将复杂问题分解为SE(2)和R2子问题，并利用SVSDF优化器进行轨迹生成，显著提高了任意形状地面机器人在复杂环境中的规划效率和连续碰撞避免能力。其局限性在于没有明确说明SVSDF优化器在不同复杂场景下的具体性能表现。

title: Spatial Polarization Multiplexing: Single-Shot Invisible Shape and Reflectance Recovery
summary: We propose spatial polarization multiplexing (SPM) for joint sensing of shape and reflectance of a static or dynamic deformable object, which is also invisible to the naked eye. Past structured-light methods are limited to shape acquisition and cannot recover reflectance as they alter scene appearance. Our key idea is to spatially multiplex a polarization pattern to encode the incident ray and also densely sample the reflected light. We derive a quantized polarized light pattern that can be robustly and uniquely decoded from the reflected Angle of Linear Polarization (AoLP) values. It also enables single-shot disentanglement of polarimetric diffuse and specular reflections for accurate BRDF estimation. We achieve this spatial polarization multiplexing (SPM) with a constrained de Bruijn sequence. We validate this novel invisible single-shot shape and reflectance method with real static and dynamic objects. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of SPM for accurate shape and BRDF measurement which opens new avenues of application for 3D sensing thanks to its invisibility and ability to jointly recover the radiometric properties.

AI.title_translation: 空间偏振复用：单次拍摄的隐形形状与反射率恢复
AI.tldr: 提出一种名为空间偏振复用（SPM）的新技术，能够单次拍摄同时恢复物体形状和反射率，并且对人眼是隐形的，解决了以往结构光方法只能获取形状且会改变场景外观的局限性。
AI.motivation: 以往的结构光方法仅限于形状获取，无法恢复反射率，并且会改变场景外观。本研究旨在开发一种能够同时恢复形状和反射率，且对人眼不可见的技术。
AI.method: 通过空间复用偏振模式来编码入射光线并密集采样反射光。设计了一种可量化的偏振光模式，该模式可以通过反射光的线性偏振角度（AoLP）值进行鲁棒且唯一的解码。利用约束的de Bruijn序列实现空间偏振复用（SPM），从而实现单次拍摄即可分离极化漫反射和镜面反射，用于精确的BRDF估计。
AI.result: 通过对真实静态和动态物体进行验证，证明了SPM技术在精确测量形状和BRDF方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SPM技术是一种新颖的、隐形且单次拍摄的形状和反射率恢复方法，它能够同时恢复辐射度属性，为3D传感开辟了新的应用途径。
AI.translation: 我们提出了空间偏振复用（SPM），用于对静态或动态可变形物体的形状和反射率进行联合感知，该物体对肉眼也是不可见的。过去结构光方法仅限于形状获取，无法恢复反射率，因为它们会改变场景外观。我们的核心思想是空间复用偏振模式来编码入射光线，并密集采样反射光。我们推导了一种可量化的偏振光模式，该模式可以通过反射光的线性偏振角度（AoLP）值进行鲁棒且唯一的解码。它还可以实现单次拍摄即可分离极化漫反射和镜面反射，用于精确的BRDF估计。我们利用约束的de Bruijn序列实现了这种空间偏振复用（SPM）。我们用真实的静态和动态物体验证了这种新颖的、隐形的、单次拍摄的形状和反射率方法。结果证明了SPM在精确形状和BRDF测量方面的有效性，由于其隐形性和联合恢复辐射度属性的能力，为3D传感开辟了新的应用途径。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为空间偏振复用（SPM）的新型3D传感技术，能够单次拍摄同时恢复物体的形状和反射率，并且对人眼是不可见的。该方法通过空间复用偏振模式来编码入射光和采样反射光，并利用线性偏振角度（AoLP）值进行解码，从而实现形状和反射率的分离，并能精确估计BRDF。实验结果表明，SPM在静态和动态物体上均表现出色，为3D传感领域带来了新的应用前景。
AI.keywords: 空间偏振复用, 形状恢复, 反射率恢复, 单次拍摄, BRDF估计
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的SPM技术，解决了传统方法在反射率恢复和场景外观保持方面的不足。其单次拍摄、隐形和联合恢复形状与反射率的特性使其在3D传感领域具有重要应用价值。然而，对于复杂材质或动态场景下的鲁棒性仍需进一步探讨。

title: SignX: Continuous Sign Recognition in Compact Pose-Rich Latent Space
comments: 23 pages, CSLR SOTA (2026). More demo at https://signerx.github.io/SignX/
summary: The complexity of sign language data processing brings many challenges. The current approach to recognition of ASL signs aims to translate RGB sign language videos through pose information into English-based ID Glosses, which serve to uniquely identify ASL signs. This paper proposes SignX, a novel framework for continuous sign language recognition in compact pose-rich latent space. First, we construct a unified latent representation that encodes heterogeneous pose formats (SMPLer-X, DWPose, Mediapipe, PrimeDepth, and Sapiens Segmentation) into a compact, information-dense space. Second, we train a ViT-based Video2Pose module to extract this latent representation directly from raw videos. Finally, we develop a temporal modeling and sequence refinement method that operates entirely in this latent space. This multi-stage design achieves end-to-end sign language recognition while significantly reducing computational consumption. Experimental results demonstrate that SignX achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on continuous sign language recognition.
comment: 23 pages, CSLR SOTA (2026). More demo at https://signerx.github.io/SignX/

AI.title_translation: SignX：紧凑姿态丰富潜在空间中的连续手语识别
AI.tldr: 提出SignX框架，通过将多种姿态格式编码成紧凑潜在空间，并使用ViT模型直接从视频中提取该表示，实现端到端、SOTA准确率的连续手语识别，同时大幅降低计算消耗。
AI.motivation: 解决手语数据处理的复杂性带来的挑战，并改进现有通过姿态信息将RGB手语视频翻译成ID Glosses的ASL识别方法。
AI.method: 提出SignX多阶段框架：1. 构建统一的潜在表示，将异构姿态格式（如SMPLer-X、DWPose、Mediapipe、PrimeDepth和Sapiens Segmentation）编码成一个紧凑、信息密集的空间。2. 训练一个基于ViT的Video2Pose模块，直接从原始视频中提取该潜在表示。3. 开发一种完全在该潜在空间中操作的时序建模和序列精炼方法。
AI.result: 实现了端到端手语识别，显著减少了计算消耗，并在连续手语识别任务上达到了最先进（SOTA）的准确率。
AI.translation: 手语数据处理的复杂性带来了许多挑战。当前的ASL手语识别方法旨在通过姿态信息将RGB手语视频翻译成基于英语的ID Glosses，用于唯一标识ASL手语。本文提出了SignX，一个用于在紧凑姿态丰富潜在空间中进行连续手语识别的新颖框架。首先，我们构建了一个统一的潜在表示，将异构姿态格式（SMPLer-X、DWPose、Mediapipe、PrimeDepth和Sapiens Segmentation）编码成一个紧凑、信息密集的空间。其次，我们训练了一个基于ViT的Video2Pose模块，可以直接从原始视频中提取这种潜在表示。最后，我们开发了一种完全在这个潜在空间中操作的时序建模和序列精炼方法。这种多阶段设计实现了端到端的手语识别，同时显著减少了计算消耗。实验结果表明，SignX在连续手语识别上取得了最先进的准确率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SignX框架，旨在解决手语识别的挑战。SignX通过三个阶段实现连续手语识别：首先，它将多种异构姿态格式（如SMPLer-X和Mediapipe）统一编码到一个紧凑、信息密集的潜在空间中；其次，利用基于ViT的Video2Pose模块直接从原始视频中提取这一潜在表示；最后，在潜在空间中进行时序建模和序列精炼。该设计实现了端到端识别，显著降低了计算量，并达到了连续手语识别任务的SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: 连续手语识别, 潜在空间, 姿态信息, ViT, 端到端
AI.comments: 创新点在于提出了SignX框架，核心思想是构建一个“姿态丰富但紧凑”的统一潜在空间来整合多种异构姿态信息，并利用ViT模块直接从原始视频中提取该表示。这种方法有效地绕过了传统手语识别中处理复杂、高维姿态数据的计算瓶颈，通过在低维潜在空间中进行时序建模，实现了计算效率和识别准确率（SOTA）的双重提升。

title: Beyond Platforms -- Growing Distributed Transaction Networks for Digital Commerce
comments: 60 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Accepted for publication Journal Information and Software Technology
summary: We talk of the internet as digital infrastructure; but we leave the building of rails and roads to the quasi-monopolistic platform providers. Decentralised architectures provide a number of advantages: They are potentially more inclusive for small players; more resilient against adversarial events; and seem to generate more innovation. However, it is not well understood how to evolve, adapt and govern decentralised infrastructures. This article reports qualitative empirical research on the development and governance of the Beckn Protocol, an open source protocol for decentralised transactions, the successful development of domain-specific adaptations, and implementation and scaling of commercial infrastructures based on it. It explores how the architecture and governance support local innovation for specific business domains, and how the domain-specific innovations feed back into the development of the core concept The research applied a case study approach, combining interviews with core members of the Beckn community; triangulated by interviews with community leaders of domain specific adaptations and by analysis of online documents and the protocol itself. The article shows the possibility of such a decentralised approach to IT Infrastructures. It analyses the Beckn Protocol, domain specific adaptations, and networks built as a software ecosystem. Based on this analysis, a number of generative mechanisms, socio-technical arrangements that support adoption, innovation, and scaling of infrastructures are highlighted.
comment: 60 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Accepted for publication Journal Information and Software Technology

title: PartHOI: Part-based Hand-Object Interaction Transfer via Generalized Cylinders
comments: 14 pages, 12 figures, this paper has been accepted by Computational Visual Media Journal (CVMJ) but has not been published yet
summary: Learning-based methods to understand and model hand-object interactions (HOI) require a large amount of high-quality HOI data. One way to create HOI data is to transfer hand poses from a source object to another based on the objects' geometry. However, current methods for transferring hand poses between objects rely on shape matching, limiting the ability to transfer poses across different categories due to differences in their shapes and sizes. We observe that HOI often involves specific semantic parts of objects, which often have more consistent shapes across categories. In addition, constructing size-invariant correspondences between these parts is important for cross-category transfer. Based on these insights, we introduce a novel method PartHOI for part-based HOI transfer. Using a generalized cylinder representation to parameterize an object parts' geometry, PartHOI establishes a robust geometric correspondence between object parts, and enables the transfer of contact points. Given the transferred points, we optimize a hand pose to fit the target object well. Qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that our method can generalize HOI transfers well even for cross-category objects, and produce high-fidelity results that are superior to the existing methods.

title: UniversalRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Corpora of Diverse Modalities and Granularities
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has shown substantial promise in improving factual accuracy by grounding model responses with external knowledge relevant to queries. However, most existing approaches are limited to a text-only corpus, and while recent efforts have extended RAG to other modalities such as images and videos, they typically operate over a single modality-specific corpus. In contrast, real-world queries vary widely in the type of knowledge they require, which a single type of knowledge source cannot address. To address this, we introduce UniversalRAG, designed to retrieve and integrate knowledge from heterogeneous sources with diverse modalities and granularities. Specifically, motivated by the observation that forcing all modalities into a unified representation space derived from a single aggregated corpus causes a modality gap, where the retrieval tends to favor items from the same modality as the query, we propose modality-aware routing, which dynamically identifies the most appropriate modality-specific corpus and performs targeted retrieval within it, and further justify its effectiveness with a theoretical analysis. Moreover, beyond modality, we organize each modality into multiple granularity levels, enabling fine-tuned retrieval tailored to the complexity and scope of the query. We validate UniversalRAG on 10 benchmarks of multiple modalities, showing its superiority over various modality-specific and unified baselines.

title: The Great Data Standoff: Researchers vs. Platforms Under the Digital Services Act
comments: To appear at the 20th International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media (ICWSM 2026)
summary: To facilitate accountability and transparency, the Digital Services Act (DSA) sets up a process through which Very Large Online Platforms (VLOPs) need to grant vetted researchers access to their internal data (Article 40(4)). Operationalising such access is challenging for at least two reasons. First, data access is only available for research on systemic risks affecting European citizens, a concept with high levels of legal uncertainty. Second, data access suffers from an inherent standoff problem. Researchers need to request specific data but are not in a position to know all internal data processed by VLOPs, who, in turn, expect data specificity for potential access. In light of these limitations, data access under the DSA remains a mystery. To contribute to the discussion of how Article 40 can be interpreted and applied, we provide a concrete illustration of what data access can look like in a real-world systemic risk case study. We focus on the 2024 Romanian presidential election interference incident, the first event of its kind to trigger systemic risk investigations by the European Commission. During the elections, one candidate is said to have benefited from TikTok algorithmic amplification through a complex dis- and misinformation campaign. By analysing this incident, we can comprehend election-related systemic risk to explore practical research tasks and compare necessary data with available TikTok data. In particular, we make two contributions: (i) we combine insights from law, computer science and platform governance to shed light on the complexities of studying systemic risks in the context of election interference, focusing on two relevant factors: platform manipulation and hidden advertising; and (ii) we provide practical insights into various categories of available data for the study of TikTok, based on platform documentation, data donations and the Research API.
